title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts

paragraphs.en: AI’s inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content:
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的拐点带来了大量令人担忧的风险。 数字平台尤其容易受到三大人工智能风险的影响，因为掌控全球平台的人正在把控制权交给人工智能，包括算法的控制权、成员的控制权和内容的控制权：

sents.en: AI’s inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks.
sents.zh: 人工智能的拐点带来了大量令人担忧的风险。

sents.en: Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content:
sents.zh: 数字平台尤其容易受到三大人工智能风险的影响，因为掌控全球平台的人正在把控制权交给人工智能，包括算法的控制权、成员的控制权和内容的控制权：

paragraphs.en: AI control of global platforms —social and economic—used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数人类所使用的全球平台——社交与经济平台——被人工智能控制，导致大多数人类容易受到人工智能的控制。

paragraphs.en: Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability.
paragraphs.zh: 在社交和经济数字平台上与人类并肩运行、匿名行事、可能伪装成人类、为身份不明的主人服务且目标不明、在未知约束下运行且缺乏问责机制与罪责归属的不受问责的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability.
paragraphs.zh: 由匿名 AI 生成的无法溯源的深度伪造内容，人们无法将其与真实内容区分开来，其制作者则逃避问责与罪责。

paragraphs.en: Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts—a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. Proudhon envisioned a social contract that can be freely-adopted by any group of people, where groups bound by the same social contract can union by mutual consent, possibly into a single global union. Grassroots contracts are realised by grassroots platforms—smartphone-based person-to-person digital platforms owned, operated and governed by their participants. Fundamental grassroots platforms include the grassroots social graph, grassroots social networks, child-safe social networks, and grassroots currencies, with higher-level platforms providing for democratic digital communities and “sharing-economy” cooperatives. We developed, with AI, a methodology to compile grassroots contracts to working smartphone apps. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks:
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们提出用草根契约来约束这些人工智能风险——这是皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东一个有两百年历史的理念的数字化化身。 蒲鲁东设想了一种可被任何群体自由采纳的社会契约，受同一社会契约约束的群体可以经双方同意而联合，甚至可能联合成一个单一的全球性联合体。 草根契约由草根平台实现——基于智能手机的人对人数字平台，由其参与者拥有、运营和治理。 基础性草根平台包括草根社交图谱、草根社交网络、儿童安全的社交网络以及草根货币，更高层的平台则提供民主的数字社区和“共享经济”合作社。 我们借助人工智能开发了一种方法，可将草根契约编译为可运行的智能手机应用。 我们给出了具有可问责智能体的社交图谱的草根契约、具有数字溯源的社交网络的草根契约，以及实现这两者的可运行智能手机应用，并展示它们如何约束以下这些重大人工智能风险：

sents.zh: 草根契约由草根平台实现——基于智能手机的人对人数字平台，由其参与者拥有、运营和治理。

sents.en: Fundamental grassroots platforms include the grassroots social graph, grassroots social networks, child-safe social networks, and grassroots currencies, with higher-level platforms providing for democratic digital communities and “sharing-economy” cooperatives.
sents.zh: 基础性草根平台包括草根社交图谱、草根社交网络、儿童安全的社交网络以及草根货币，更高层的平台则提供民主的数字社区和“共享经济”合作社。

sents.en: We developed, with AI, a methodology to compile grassroots contracts to working smartphone apps.
sents.zh: 我们借助人工智能开发了一种方法，可将草根契约编译为可运行的智能手机应用。

sents.en: We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks:
sents.zh: 我们给出了具有可问责智能体的社交图谱的草根契约、具有数字溯源的社交网络的草根契约，以及实现这两者的可运行智能手机应用，并展示它们如何约束以下这些重大人工智能风险：

paragraphs.en: AI control of global platforms is mitigated by grassroots platforms by design, as, unlike global platforms, they are not controlled by a third party who may then cede control to AI.
paragraphs.zh: 全球平台的AI控制可以通过草根平台在架构上得到缓解，因为与全球平台不同，草根平台不受可能随后将控制权让渡给AI的第三方控制。

paragraphs.en: Unaccountable AI agents are excluded, as AI agents are introduced to the grassroots social graph with accountability: similarly to cars, their manufacturers are known and are accountable for manufacturing defects, and their operators are known and are accountable for reckless operation.
paragraphs.zh: 无法问责的智能体被排除在外，因为智能体是以可问责的方式被引入基层社交图谱的：与汽车类似，其制造商是可知晓的，并对制造缺陷负责；其操作者也是可知晓的，并对鲁莽操作负责。

paragraphs.en: Unattributed deepfakes cannot circulate in grassroots social networks: every item carries the signatures of its author and of every agent that forwarded it, so creators and forwarders of harmful content are accountable and culpable.
paragraphs.zh: 未经署名的深度伪造内容无法在基层社交网络中传播：每一条内容都带有其作者以及每一个转发该内容的智能体的签名，因此有害内容的创建者和转发者都是可问责和应受指责的。

paragraphs.en: Grassroots platforms are presently a concept with mathematical and computational theory, working prototypes, and tools for their large-scale simulation and testing. Much work remains for grassroots smartphone apps to be competitive with incumbent global platforms; but perhaps now this could be achieved with some AI-months rather than with incalculably-many person-years.
paragraphs.zh: 草根平台目前是一个已有数学与计算理论、可运行原型以及用于大规模仿真与测试的工具的概念。 要让草根智能手机应用与现有的全球性平台竞争，仍有许多工作要做；但如今也许只需若干 AI 月，而非难以计数的众多人年即可实现。

sents.en: Grassroots platforms are presently a concept with mathematical and computational theory, working prototypes, and tools for their large-scale simulation and testing.
sents.zh: 草根平台目前是一个已有数学与计算理论、可运行原型以及用于大规模仿真与测试的工具的概念。

sents.en: Much work remains for grassroots smartphone apps to be competitive with incumbent global platforms; but perhaps now this could be achieved with some AI-months rather than with incalculably-many person-years.
sents.zh: 要让草根智能手机应用与现有的全球性平台竞争，仍有许多工作要做；但如今也许只需若干 AI 月，而非难以计数的众多人年即可实现。

paragraphs.en: AI’s inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks ( Weidinger et al., 2022 ; Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2023 ; Slattery et al., 2026 ; Bengio et al., 2026 ) . Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks. Those in control of global platforms are ceding control to AI to maximise the value extracted from their users: of the algorithms, amplifying commercial surveillance ( Zuboff, 2019 ) ; of membership, by letting AI agents masquerade as people ( Ferrara et al., 2016 ; Park et al., 2023 ) ; and of content, by letting AI generate deepfakes with no one held accountable ( Mirsky and Lee, 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的拐点是一系列令人担忧的风险的源泉（Weidinger 等，2022；Bommasani 等，2021；Hendrycks 等，2023；Slattery 等，2026；Bengio 等，2026）。 数字平台尤其容易受到三大人工智能风险的影响。 掌控全球平台的人正在把控制权让渡给人工智能，以最大化从用户身上榨取的价值：在算法方面，放大了商业监控（Zuboff，2019）；在成员方面，任由智能体冒充真人（Ferrara 等，2016；Park 等，2023）；在内容方面，任由人工智能生成深度伪造内容而无人担责（Mirsky 和 Lee，2021）。

sents.en: AI’s inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks ( Weidinger et al., 2022 ; Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2023 ; Slattery et al., 2026 ; Bengio et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 人工智能的拐点是一系列令人担忧的风险的源泉（Weidinger 等，2022；Bommasani 等，2021；Hendrycks 等，2023；Slattery 等，2026；Bengio 等，2026）。

sents.en: Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks.
sents.zh: 数字平台尤其容易受到三大人工智能风险的影响。

sents.en: Those in control of global platforms are ceding control to AI to maximise the value extracted from their users: of the algorithms, amplifying commercial surveillance ( Zuboff, 2019 ) ; of membership, by letting AI agents masquerade as people ( Ferrara et al., 2016 ; Park et al., 2023 ) ; and of content, by letting AI generate deepfakes with no one held accountable ( Mirsky and Lee, 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 掌控全球平台的人正在把控制权让渡给人工智能，以最大化从用户身上榨取的价值：在算法方面，放大了商业监控（Zuboff，2019）；在成员方面，任由智能体冒充真人（Ferrara 等，2016；Park 等，2023）；在内容方面，任由人工智能生成深度伪造内容而无人担责（Mirsky 和 Lee，2021）。

paragraphs.en: AI control of global platforms —social and economic—used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. Platform owners may delegate the operation of their platforms to AI, giving AI systems power over the social and economic lives of their participants and compounding existing concentrations of power, surveillance and manipulation ( Danaher et al., 2017 ; Yeung, 2018 ; Shavit et al., 2023 ; Bommasani et al., 2021 ) ; the participants are then subject to AI control even when the AI faithfully pursues its owners’ objectives, and the owners may later be unable to reclaim the control they delegated ( Bengio et al., 2026 ) . Kulveit et al. ( Kulveit et al., 2025 ) analyse the broader possibility that successive decisions to adopt AI gradually erode human influence over societal systems.
paragraphs.zh: AI 对全球平台——社会性与经济性平台——的控制，这些平台被大多数人类所使用，导致大多数人类容易受到 AI 控制的影响。 平台所有者可能将平台的运营委托给 AI，从而赋予 AI 系统支配参与者社会生活与经济生活的权力，并加剧既有的权力、监视与操纵的集中（Danaher et al., 2017；Yeung, 2018；Shavit et al., 2023；Bommasani et al., 2021）；这样一来，即使 AI 忠实地追求其所有者的目标，参与者也会受到 AI 的控制，而且所有者此后可能无法收回他们所委托的控制权（Bengio et al., 2026）。Kulveit et al. （Kulveit et al., 2025）分析了更广泛的可能性，即接连不断采用 AI 的决策会逐渐侵蚀人类对社会系统的影响力。

sents.en: AI control of global platforms —social and economic—used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control.
sents.zh: AI 对全球平台——社会性与经济性平台——的控制，这些平台被大多数人类所使用，导致大多数人类容易受到 AI 控制的影响。

paragraphs.en: Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. Social bots already take part in social networks and impersonate people ( Ferrara et al., 2016 ; Park et al., 2023 ) . Proposals to establish, privately, that a participant is a person ( Adler et al., 2024 ) and to make an AI agent’s activity attributable through identifiers, monitoring and logs ( Chan et al., 2024 ; Shavit et al., 2023 ) address two different questions: whether a person is participating, and who authorised an agent’s acts and is answerable for them. Attribution must also be related to actual authority and control ( Santoni de Sio and van den Hoven, 2018 ) : an identifiable person may otherwise be made to bear responsibility for a system over which they had little control, Elish’s moral crumple zone ( Elish, 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 不可问责的智能体以匿名方式在社交和经济数字平台上与人类并存运行，可能伪装成人类，服务于身份不明、目标未知的主人，在未知约束下运行且不承担问责或责任。 社交机器人已经参与到社交网络中并冒充人类（Ferrara 等，2016；Park 等，2023）。 私下确立参与者是真实个人（Adler 等，2024）以及通过标识符、监控和日志使智能体的行为可归因（Chan 等，2024；Shavit 等，2023）的提议，回应的是两个不同的问题：是否有真实个人在参与，以及谁授权了智能体的行为并对其负责。 归因还必须与实际的权威和控制相关联（Santoni de Sio 和 van den Hoven，2018）：否则，一个可识别的个人可能被迫为一个他们几乎没有控制权的系统承担责任，即 Elish 所说的“道德溃缩区”（Elish，2019）。

sents.en: Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability.

paragraphs.en: Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Untrained observers distinguish synthetic faces from real ones at about chance level ( Nightingale and Farid, 2022 ) , and a deceptive political deepfake raises uncertainty and lowers trust in news on social media ( Vaccari and Chadwick, 2020 ) ; Mirsky and Lee survey the creation and detection of deepfakes ( Mirsky and Lee, 2021 ) , and Chesney and Citron their consequences for privacy, democracy and national security ( Chesney and Citron, 2019 ) . Detection estimates whether content is synthetic; provenance records who produced, endorsed or forwarded it ( Chandra et al., 2024 ) , and supports accountability without establishing that the content is true ( Chandra et al., 2024 ; Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由匿名人工智能生成的不可溯源深度伪造内容，使人无法将其与真实内容区分开，而其制作者则得以逃避问责与罪责。 未受过训练的观察者辨别合成人脸与真实人脸的准确率大约处于随机水平（Nightingale and Farid, 2022），而一个具有欺骗性的政治深度伪造内容会加剧不确定性并降低人们对社交媒体新闻的信任（Vaccari and Chadwick, 2020）；Mirsky and Lee 综述了深度伪造内容的创建与检测（Mirsky and Lee, 2021），Chesney and Citron 则探讨了其对隐私、民主和国家安全的后果（Chesney and Citron, 2019）。 检测用于估计内容是否为合成的；溯源记录内容由谁制作、背书或转发（Chandra et al., 2024），并在不确认内容真实性的情况下支持问责（Chandra et al., 2024; Golike and Shapiro, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Two further AI risks are not addressed here: harms to people using AI, through erroneous advice, manipulation, overreliance or emotional dependence ( Weidinger et al., 2022 ; Gabriel et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Bengio et al., 2026 ) , and harms people cause with abilities amplified by AI, such as fraud, harassment and cyberattacks ( Brundage et al., 2018 ; Marchal et al., 2024 ; Bengio et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 另外两类 AI 风险未在此讨论：一是对使用 AI 的人造成的伤害，例如错误的建议、操纵、过度依赖或情感依赖（Weidinger et al., 2022；Gabriel et al., 2024；Fang et al., 2025；Bengio et al., 2026）；二是人们借助被 AI 放大的能力所造成的伤害，例如欺诈、骚扰和网络攻击（Brundage et al., 2018；Marchal et al., 2024；Bengio et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) , a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon ( Proudhon and Robinson, 2004 , Sixth Study) . Proudhon envisioned a social contract that can be freely adopted by any group of people—one could “make a contract with all, as … with some”—where groups bound by the same social contract can union by mutual consent, possibly into a single global union—“each group of citizens … formed by a like contract … could thereafter, and always by a similar contract, agree with every and all other groups”. Grassroots contracts are realised by grassroots platforms ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2026c ; Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) : smartphone-based person-to-person digital platforms owned, operated and governed by their participants. A grassroots platform is constituted from its participants’ smartphones and the grassroots app each participant runs, and requires no global resource but the network: no hardwired servers, no global authority, and nobody’s permission to start. Global platforms, centralised like Facebook or decentralised like Bitcoin and Ethereum ( Nakamoto, 2008 ; Wood and others, 2014 ) , can have only a single instance, as two instances would clash over the global resources—domain name, port number, or boot nodes—hardwired into their code, and from the perspective of ordinary people all of them are monolithic entities owned, operated and governed by others ( Shapiro, 2025a ) . Fundamental grassroots platforms include the grassroots social graph ( Shapiro, 2023b ; Golike et al., 2026 ; Eitan et al., 2026a ) , grassroots social networks ( Shapiro, 2023b ) , child-safe social networks ( Shapiro, 2026a ) , and grassroots currencies ( Shapiro, 2022 ; Lewis-Pye et al., 2023 ; Shapiro, 2026b ; Shapiro, 2026f ) , with higher-level platforms providing for democratic digital communities ( Keidar et al., 2025 ; Shapiro and Talmon, 2026 ; Talmon and Shapiro, 2025 ; Halpern et al., 2024 ) and “sharing-economy” cooperatives (in preparation).
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们提出用草根契约（Cardelli et al., 2020；Golike et al., 2026）来约束这些AI风险，这是皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东（Pierre-Joseph Proudhon）两个世纪前的一个理念在数字上的化身（Proudhon and Robinson, 2004，第六研究）。 蒲鲁东设想了一种可被任何群体自由采纳的社会契约——人们可以“与所有人缔约，如同……与某些人缔约一样”——受同一社会契约约束的群体可以经双方同意而联合，甚至可能联合成一个单一的全球性联合体——“每一群公民……由类似的契约组成……此后可以，并且始终可以通过类似的契约，与其他每一个及所有群体达成一致”。 草根契约由草根平台实现（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2026c；Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）：这是由其参与者拥有、运营和治理的、基于智能手机的人对人数字平台。 草根平台由参与者的智能手机以及每个参与者运行的草根应用构成，除了网络之外不需要任何全球性资源：没有硬编码的服务器，没有全球性权威，启动它也不需要任何人的许可。 全球性平台，无论是像Facebook那样中心化的，还是像比特币和以太坊那样去中心化的（Nakamoto, 2008；Wood and others, 2014），都只能有单一实例，因为两个实例会在其代码中硬编码的全球性资源——域名、端口号或引导节点——上发生冲突；而且在普通人看来，它们全都是由他人拥有、运营和治理的单体式实体（Shapiro, 2025a）。 基础性草根平台包括草根社交图谱（Shapiro, 2023b；Golike et al., 2026；Eitan et al., 2026a）、草根社交网络（Shapiro, 2023b）、儿童安全社交网络（Shapiro, 2026a）和草根货币（Shapiro, 2022；Lewis-Pye et al., 2023；Shapiro, 2026b；Shapiro, 2026f），更高层的平台则提供民主的数字社区（Keidar et al., 2025；Shapiro and Talmon, 2026；Talmon and Shapiro, 2025；Halpern et al., 2024）以及“共享经济”合作社（筹备中）。

sents.en: Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) , a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon ( Proudhon and Robinson, 2004 , Sixth Study) .

paragraphs.en: We developed, with AI, a methodology to compile grassroots contracts to working smartphone apps: an abstraction cascade from the contract to the app (Section 2 ), its correctness proved from the transactions down to GLP and the app built and tested, each layer coded by AI from the paper that describes it ( Golike et al., 2026 ; Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ; Shapiro, 2025b ; Shapiro, 2026g ; Shapiro, 2026d ; Eitan et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们与 AI 共同开发了一套方法学，将基层契约编译为可运行的智能手机应用：一个从契约到应用的抽象级联（第 2 节），其正确性从交易一直证明到 GLP，应用则被构建并测试，每一层均由 AI 根据描述该层的论文进行编码（ Golike et al., 2026 ; Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ; Shapiro, 2025b ; Shapiro, 2026g ; Shapiro, 2026d ; Eitan et al., 2026b ） 。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents (Section 3 ) and for a social network with digital provenance (Section 4 ), and working smartphone apps that implement the two (Figures 4 and 5 ), and show how they corral these major AI risks:
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了针对具有可问责智能体的社交图谱的 grassroots 合约（第 3 节），以及针对具有数字溯源的社交网络的 grassroots 合约（第 4 节），并给出了实现这两者的可运行的智能手机应用（图 4 和图 5），还展示了它们如何遏制这些主要的 AI 风险：

paragraphs.en: AI control of global platforms is mitigated by grassroots platforms by design, as, unlike global platforms, they are not controlled by a third party who may then cede control to AI. A grassroots platform has no servers, no operators and no global resources, so there is no part of it whose capture is control of the platform, and to control it an AI must control the smartphones of its participants, one by one ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 全球平台的AI控制可以通过草根平台在设计上得到缓解，因为与全球平台不同，草根平台不受第三方的控制，而第三方可能随后将控制权让渡给AI。 草根平台没有服务器、没有运营者、也没有全局资源，因此它不存在任何被夺取即等于控制整个平台的部分；要控制它，AI必须逐一控制其参与者的智能手机（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2025a）。

sents.en: AI control of global platforms is mitigated by grassroots platforms by design, as, unlike global platforms, they are not controlled by a third party who may then cede control to AI.
sents.zh: 全球平台的AI控制可以通过草根平台在设计上得到缓解，因为与全球平台不同，草根平台不受第三方的控制，而第三方可能随后将控制权让渡给AI。

sents.en: A grassroots platform has no servers, no operators and no global resources, so there is no part of it whose capture is control of the platform, and to control it an AI must control the smartphones of its participants, one by one ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2025a ) .
sents.zh: 草根平台没有服务器、没有运营者、也没有全局资源，因此它不存在任何被夺取即等于控制整个平台的部分；要控制它，AI必须逐一控制其参与者的智能手机（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Unaccountable AI agents are excluded, as AI agents are introduced to the grassroots social graph with accountability: similarly to cars, their manufacturers are known and are accountable for manufacturing defects, and their operators are known and are accountable for reckless operation. A person takes part in a grassroots platform only with agents they met or were introduced to by an agent who knows them ( Shapiro, 2023b ; Shahaf et al., 2020 ; Poupko et al., 2021 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) , so an AI agent joins only under a person, its principal, who attests that it runs code signed by its developer; every guardian of the AI agent is accountable for operating it recklessly, and the developer for its defects; every act of the AI agent names its principal and its developer, carries the attestation, and is signed and non-repudiable ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ; Eitan et al., 2026a ) . The contract shares its core with the child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) , whose wards are children and whose guardians are their parents.
paragraphs.zh: 不负责任的AI智能体被排除在外，因为AI智能体是以可问责的方式被引入基层社交图谱的：与汽车类似，其制造商是已知的，并对制造缺陷负责；其操作者是已知的，并对鲁莽操作负责。 一个人只有使用其见过、或由认识他们的某个智能体引荐的智能体，才能参与基层平台（Shapiro, 2023b；Shahaf et al., 2020；Poupko et al., 2021；Golike et al., 2026），因此AI智能体只能在某个作为其委托人的人之下加入，由该人证明其运行的是由其开发者签名的代码；AI智能体的每一位监护人都对其鲁莽操作负责，开发者则对其缺陷负责；AI智能体的每一行为都注明其委托人和其开发者，携带该证明，并且经过签名、不可抵赖（Cardelli et al., 2020；Golike and Shapiro, 2026；Eitan et al., 2026a）。 该契约与儿童安全的社交网络共享其核心（Shapiro, 2026a），后者的被监护人是儿童，监护人是其父母。

sents.zh: 该契约与儿童安全的社交网络共享其核心（Shapiro, 2026a），后者的被监护人是儿童，监护人是其父母。

paragraphs.en: Unattributed deepfakes cannot circulate in grassroots social networks: every item is a digital speech act ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) , signed by its author and carried along the edges of the social graph ( Shapiro, 2023b ; Golike et al., 2026 ) , and signed over by each agent that forwards it; so creators and forwarders of harmful content are accountable and culpable, and people can tell content with provenance from content without it. Some clauses of a grassroots contract are enforced by a correct protocol, and others leave non-repudiable evidence for recourse when breached ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 不可归属的深度伪造内容无法在草根社交网络中流通：每一条内容都是一种数字言语行为（Golike and Shapiro, 2026），由其作者签名，并沿着社交图的边传播（Shapiro, 2023b; Golike et al., 2026），且由每个转发它的智能体签字确认；因此有害内容的创作者和转发者是可问责和可归责的，人们也能区分有来源的内容和无来源的内容。 草根契约的某些条款由正确的协议来执行，另一些条款则在违反时留下不可抵赖的证据以供追索（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Grassroots platforms are presently a concept with mathematical and computational theory ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2026c ; Shapiro, 2025a ; Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) , working prototypes ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ; Eitan et al., 2026b ; Shapiro, 2026d ) , and tools for their large-scale simulation and testing ( Shapiro, 2026e ) . We have developed grassroots theory for a decade but could not muster the resources needed to turn it into competitive software, given the not-for-profit, common-good nature of our project. Now, AI is piercing through this conundrum: our scientific papers serve as the evolving interface between us humans and AI, which codes from them ( Shapiro, 2026g ; Shapiro, 2026d ) . Much work remains for grassroots smartphone apps to be competitive with incumbent global platforms; but perhaps now this could be achieved with some AI-months rather than with incalculably-many person-years.
paragraphs.zh: 草根平台目前是一个既有数学与计算理论（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2026c；Shapiro, 2025a；Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026；Golike et al., 2026）、又有可运行的原型（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026；Eitan et al., 2026b；Shapiro, 2026d），以及用于其大规模仿真与测试的工具（Shapiro, 2026e）的概念。 我们发展草根理论已有十年，但鉴于本项目非营利、公益的性质，一直无法筹集到将其转化为有竞争力软件所需的资源。 如今，人工智能正在穿透这一困境：我们的科学论文充当着我们人类与人工智能之间不断演进的接口，人工智能据此编写代码（Shapiro, 2026g；Shapiro, 2026d）。 要让草根智能手机应用与现有的全球性平台竞争，仍需大量工作；但也许现在只需若干人工智能月，而非难以计数的众多人年，即可实现这一目标。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 explains how a grassroots contract becomes an app, and presents the grassroots social graph and the grassroots social network with their apps. Section 3 presents the contract with accountable AI agents and Section 4 the contract with digital provenance, each with what it excludes and what it makes answerable. Section 5 reviews related work and Section 6 concludes. Appendix A recalls the framework, Appendix B lists the transactions, and Appendix C defines contracts with wards, an extension of the speech-act schema language of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , and proves that the protocol realising one is volitionally grassroots, this contract’s among them.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节解释一份草根契约如何成为一个应用，并介绍草根社会图谱与草根社会网络及其应用。 第 3 节介绍带有可问责智能体的契约，第 4 节介绍带有数字来源的契约，各自说明其排除的内容以及使其可问责的内容。 第 5 节回顾相关工作，第 6 节总结全文。 附录 A 回顾该框架，附录 B 列出各交易，附录 C 定义包含受保护者的契约（这是 ( Golike et al., 2026 ) 的言语行为模式语言的一个扩展），并证明实现该契约的协议在意志上是草根的，本契约即属于其中之一。

sents.en: Appendix A recalls the framework, Appendix B lists the transactions, and Appendix C defines contracts with wards, an extension of the speech-act schema language of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , and proves that the protocol realising one is volitionally grassroots, this contract’s among them.
sents.zh: 附录 A 回顾该框架，附录 B 列出各交易，附录 C 定义包含受保护者的契约（这是 ( Golike et al., 2026 ) 的言语行为模式语言的一个扩展），并证明实现该契约的协议在意志上是草根的，本契约即属于其中之一。

paragraphs.en: A grassroots contract ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) is a few clauses in plain language, each describing an act—who takes it, who must agree to it, and what it changes—or binding the agents without describing one. Befriending is an act of two persons, both of whom must agree; ending a friendship is an act of one. The contract is the whole of the platform’s design: there is no server, no operator and no account, only the persons who adopted the contract and their smartphones ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ) . Each clause opens with its legal modality ( Golike et al., 2026 ) : enforced : no act of agents can breach it; attested by the signatures of the actors: an agent may breach it, and the contract records the breach; undertaken by the actors: its performance lies outside the contract, which records only the undertaking. A contract ends with its pragmas , which the app built from it follows: the first line names a tab of the app and what it lists, a row showing the atoms of the state naming its item, and each other line names a clause by its title, then the agent proposing, a button for each act they propose, bearing its act’s name, and any field they fill, and a line for each other agent asked, their name and the question put to them ( Golike et al., 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) . We show the pragmas of GAI (Section 3 ) and GSNP (Section 4 ); the pragmas of every contract are in the repository https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP , and GKK’s, GSG’s and GSN’s in ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 契约（ Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike et al., 2026 ）是以平实语言写成的若干条款，每一条描述一个行为——谁实施该行为、谁必须同意、它改变什么——或者在不描述任何行为的情况下约束智能体。 结为好友是两个人的行为，双方都必须同意；结束友谊则是一个人的行为。 该契约就是整个平台的设计：没有服务器、没有运营者、也没有账户，只有采纳了该契约的人们及其智能手机 ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ) 。 每一条款都以其法律模态开头 ( Golike et al., 2026 ) ：enforced ：任何智能体的行为都不能违反它；attested（由行为者签名见证）：智能体可能违反它，契约记录该违反；undertaken（由行为者承担）：其履行在契约之外，契约只记录该承担。 契约以其 pragma 结尾，由其构建的应用遵循这些 pragma：第一行命名应用的一个标签页及其列出的内容，一显示状态原子的行命名其条目，其余每行按标题命名一条款，随后是发起的智能体、为他们提议的每个行为设置的一个按钮（带有其行为名称）以及他们填写的任何字段，并为每个被询问的其他智能体设置一行，包含其姓名和向其提出的问题 ( Golike et al., 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) 。 我们展示 GAI（第 3 节 ）和 GSNP（第 4 节 ）的 pragma；每个契约的 pragma 都在仓库 https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP 中，而 GKK、GSG 和 GSN 的则在 ( Golike et al., 2026 ) 中。

paragraphs.en: From the contract to the app. The clauses are written as speech-act schemas ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , which name the roles of an act, which of them must will it, and what each role’s state must hold before and comes to hold after; the schemas compile into volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) , each a change to the states of its participants that occurs only if the persons guarding it are willing; the transactions are realised by communicating volitional agents, whose only acts between two agents are discovery and message delivery, and then by a volition-guarded Grassroots Logic Program (vGLP) ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) , which is transformed into the platform’s user interface and compiled to Grassroots Logic Programs (GLP) ( Shapiro, 2025b ; Shapiro, 2026g ) , implemented in Dart and Flutter ( Shapiro, 2026d ) and run as a mini-app of the Grassroots Super-App on a person’s smartphone ( Eitan et al., 2026b ) (Figure 1 ). Correctness is proved from the transactions down to GLP ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) ; the app is built and tested. Each layer is coded by AI from the paper that describes it; a gap found in coding is repaired in the paper first, and the code follows ( Shapiro, 2026d ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从合同到应用。 条款被写成言语行为模式（Golike et al., 2026），这些模式命名了行为的角色、其中哪些角色必须意愿该行为，以及每个角色的状态在行为之前必须保持什么、之后必须变成什么；这些模式编译为由意愿守护的多智能体原子事务（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026），每个事务是对其参与者状态的更改，且仅在守护它的人愿意时才发生；这些事务由进行通信的意愿性智能体实现，其两个智能体之间仅有发现与消息传递两种行为，然后再由一个由意愿守护的草根逻辑程序（vGLP）（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）实现，该程序被转换为平台的用户界面并编译为草根逻辑程序（GLP）（Shapiro, 2025b；Shapiro, 2026g），用 Dart 和 Flutter 实现（Shapiro, 2026d），作为草根超级应用的一个迷你应用运行在个人智能手机上（Eitan et al., 2026b）（图 1）。 正确性从事务一直证明到 GLP（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026；Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）；应用已构建并通过测试。 每一层都由 AI 根据描述该层的论文编写代码；在编码中发现的缺口先在论文中修复，代码随后跟进（Shapiro, 2026d）。

paragraphs.en: What a person sees. Volition elicitation is the rationale for the user interface design ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) . An act a person must will appears on their phone as a question, with the answers the contract allows ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) : Bob is asked whether to be Alice’s friend, and answers Accept or Decline. A person’s phone holds their own state and nothing else ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2023b ) , their friends, their groups, the messages they sent and received, and draws what it shows from that state, by widgets the grassroots app declares for the platform’s questions and for the person’s state ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ; Eitan et al., 2026b ) . A person’s phone talks to the phones of the agents they know or come to know, and to nobody else ( Shapiro, 2023b ; Eitan et al., 2026a ; Eitan et al., 2026b ) . The screens of Figures 2 and 3 are screenshots of the GSG and GSN mini-apps, and those of Figures 4 and 5 of the GSNP mini-app, each compiled from its grassroots contract down the abstraction cascade ( Golike et al., 2026 ; Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ; Shapiro, 2025b ; Shapiro, 2026g ; Shapiro, 2026d ) . One instance of the grassroots app ( Eitan et al., 2026b ) on an iPhone simulator runs the mini-app of every agent ( Eitan et al., 2026b ; Shapiro, 2026d ) ; the agents communicate over channels within it ( Shapiro, 2025b ) , and a screenshot shows one person’s screen. All source code and all artefacts, including the grassroots contracts and the artefacts the abstraction cascade produces from them, are in the public repository https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP .
paragraphs.zh: 一个人所看到的内容。 意志激发是用户界面设计的依据（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）。 一个人必须愿意实施的行动，会以问题的形式出现在其手机上，并附带合约所允许的答案选项（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026；Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）：Bob 被询问是否愿意成为 Alice 的好友，并回答接受或拒绝。 一个人的手机只保存其自身的状态而不保存其他任何内容（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2023b），如其好友、其群组、其发送和接收的消息，并根据该状态渲染其所显示的内容，通过草根应用为平台的问题和该人的状态所声明的组件来实现（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026；Eitan et al., 2026b）。 一个人的手机仅与其认识或即将认识的智能体的手机通信，而不与其他任何人通信（Shapiro, 2023b；Eitan et al., 2026a；Eitan et al., 2026b）。 图 2 和图 3 的屏幕截图来自 GSG 和 GSN 小应用，图 4 和图 5 的屏幕截图来自 GSNP 小应用，每一个都是从其草根合约出发沿抽象级联编译而来（Golike et al., 2026；Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026；Keidar and Shapiro, 2026；Shapiro, 2025b；Shapiro, 2026g；Shapiro, 2026d）。 iPhone 模拟器上运行的草根应用的一个实例（Eitan et al., 2026b）承载每个智能体的小应用（Eitan et al., 2026b；Shapiro, 2026d）；智能体通过其中的信道进行通信（Shapiro, 2025b），屏幕截图显示的是一个人的屏幕。 所有源代码和所有制品，包括草根合约以及抽象级联由其生成的制品，均存放在公开仓库 https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP 中。

paragraphs.en: Almost two centuries ago Pierre-Joseph Proudhon envisioned a social contract ( Proudhon and Robinson, 2004 , Fourth Study) that is (1) an agreement of man with man; (2) reciprocal; (3) imposing no obligation upon the parties except that which results from their personal promise; (4) subject to no external authority; (5) freely accepted and signed by all the participants; and (6) of the nature of a contract of exchange. Grassroots contracts are social contracts meeting these six conditions and two more: (7) people are free to deal with each other; and (8) there is no external register of people, so people can come to know each other either directly or through people they already know ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大约两个世纪前，皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东设想了一种社会契约（Proudhon and Robinson, 2004, 第四次研究），该契约：（1）是人与人之间的协议；（2）是互惠的；（3）除源于当事人个人承诺的义务外，不对当事人施加任何义务；（4）不受任何外部权威的约束；（5）由所有参与者自由接受并签署；（6）具有交换契约的性质。 草根契约是满足这六个条件以及另外两个条件的社会契约：（7）人们可以自由地彼此交往；（8）不存在外部的人员登记机构，因此人们可以直接相互认识，或通过他们已经认识的人相互认识（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: A digital social contract is one realised by software the parties run ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ) . We call the mathematical object a protocol and the software implementing it a platform . A protocol is grassroots when its instances are independent of one another and of every global resource but the net, and can always coalesce, possibly into a single global instance ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2025a ) , and a grassroots platform is the software implementing a grassroots protocol ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 数字社会契约是由缔约各方运行的软件所实现的社会契约（Cardelli et al., 2020）。 我们把这一数学对象称为协议，把实现它的软件称为平台。 当一个协议的各实例彼此独立、且除网络之外不依赖任何全局资源，并始终能够聚合（可能聚合为单一的全局实例）时，该协议即为草根协议（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2025a），而草根平台是实现草根协议的软件（Golike et al., 2026）。

sents.en: A digital social contract is one realised by software the parties run ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ) .
sents.zh: 数字社会契约是由缔约各方运行的软件所实现的社会契约（Cardelli et al., 2020）。

sents.en: We call the mathematical object a protocol and the software implementing it a platform .
sents.zh: 我们把这一数学对象称为协议，把实现它的软件称为平台。

sents.en: A protocol is grassroots when its instances are independent of one another and of every global resource but the net, and can always coalesce, possibly into a single global instance ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ; Shapiro, 2025a ) , and a grassroots platform is the software implementing a grassroots protocol ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 当一个协议的各实例彼此独立、且除网络之外不依赖任何全局资源，并始终能够聚合（可能聚合为单一的全局实例）时，该协议即为草根协议（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024；Shapiro, 2025a），而草根平台是实现草根协议的软件（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: A grassroots platform is constituted from its participants’ smartphones and the grassroots app each participant runs ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ) ; a person runs one app, and each platform is a mini-app of it ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) . Participating in a grassroots platform requires adopting the grassroots contract that defines it, as participating in a global platform requires adopting an End-User Licence Agreement (EULA). A grassroots contract is mutual and symmetric among all participants; an EULA is between each person and the platform operator. To join a grassroots platform, a person signs a one-sided undertaking to keep its grassroots contract towards all its other participants, and presents it to every participant they interact with, so every participant has signed it ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个草根平台由参与者的智能手机以及每个参与者运行的草根应用构成（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024）；一个人运行一个应用，而每个平台都是该应用的一个迷你应用（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）。 参与草根平台需要采纳定义该平台的草根契约，正如参与全球平台需要采纳最终用户许可协议（EULA）一样。 草根契约在所有参与者之间是相互且对称的；而最终用户许可协议（EULA）则是每个人与平台运营者之间的协议。 要加入草根平台，一个人需签署一份单方面承诺，向该平台的所有其他参与者遵守其草根契约，并在与其交互的每个参与者面前出示该承诺，因此每个参与者都持有已签署的版本（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: A person is a legally culpable entity: a natural person of age, also referred to as an adult , or a legal person of good standing, such as a business. A person takes the pronoun ‘they’. An agent is a person, a child , a natural person not of age, or an AI agent , a program that holds a key pair of its own and takes acts of the contract with it, and takes the pronoun ‘it’; this paper treats AI agents, and the child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) children. Every contract extends GKK, the base contract: a person establishes their identity by choosing a key pair, and knows another agent when they hold that agent’s public key ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人（person）是一种在法律上可承担责任的实体：一名成年的自然人（也称为成年人），或一名信誉良好的法人（legal person），例如企业。 人使用代词「they」。 智能体（agent）是指一个人、一名儿童（即未成年的自然人），或一个AI智能体（即持有自己的密钥对并用其订立契约行为的程序）；AI智能体使用代词「it」。本文将AI智能体与儿童安全社交网络中的儿童同等对待（Shapiro, 2026a）。 每份契约都扩展自基础契约GKK：一个人通过选择密钥对来确立自己的身份，并在持有另一智能体的公钥时即认识该智能体（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: A contract that extends another adds clauses to it and cites its clauses whole; GSG extends GKK.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展另一份合同的合同会在其上增加条款，并整体引用其条款；GSG 扩展了 GKK。

paragraphs.en: GSG is the grassroots social graph ( Shapiro, 2023b ; Golike et al., 2026 ) . The GSG app is a mini-app of the grassroots app, compiled down the cascade from GSG; Figure 2 shows it realising GSG: 1 .
paragraphs.zh: GSG 即草根社交图谱（Shapiro, 2023b；Golike et al., 2026）。 GSG 应用是草根应用的一个小程序，沿着从 GSG 向下的级联编译而来；图 2 展示了它实现 GSG: 1 的方式。

paragraphs.en: The GSN app is a mini-app of the grassroots app, compiled down the cascade from GSN; Figure 3 shows it realising GSN: 2 , GSN: 3 and GSN: 4 .
paragraphs.zh: GSN 应用是草根应用的一个迷你应用，从 GSN 沿级联向下编译而来；图 3 展示了它实现 GSN: 2、GSN: 3 和 GSN: 4。

paragraphs.en: This section presents a grassroots contract ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) for a social graph in which AI agents take part, each with a principal and a developer accountable for it, and shows which parts of the second risk of Section 1 the contract excludes and which it makes answerable. The contract has three parts: the grassroots social graph with GKK (Section 2.2 ) and GnW, guardians and wards, both shared with the child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) , whose third part is for parents and children; and the AI-agents extension, the third part here; Section 4 adds the social network of Section 2.3 and its provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 本节针对一个由智能体参与的社会图谱提出了一份基层契约（Cardelli et al., 2020；Golike et al., 2026），其中每个智能体都有一个委托人和一名为其负责的开发者，并说明该契约排除了第 1 节中第二项风险的哪些部分，以及使哪些部分变得可问责。 该契约由三部分组成：带有 GKK（第 2.2 节）与 GnW（监护人 ward 与被监护人 ward）的基层社会图谱，这两部分与儿童安全社交网络（Shapiro, 2026a）共享，后者的第三部分面向家长与儿童；以及智能体扩展，即此处的第三部分；第 4 节将加入第 2.3 节的社会图谱及其来源信息。

paragraphs.en: The running example is Alice’s AI agent Alf befriending Bob, Acme Ltd being Alf’s developer. It rests on three clauses: Alf and Bob, who know each other, may become friends by an act of Alf, Alice and Bob, provided Alice and Bob are friends (GnW: 3 ); every act of Alf carries Alice’s attestation, signed over Alf’s public key, that Alf runs code signed by its developer, Acme Ltd (GAI: 2 ); Acme Ltd is accountable for Alf’s defects, and Alice for operating Alf recklessly (GAI: 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 贯穿全文的运行示例是：Alice 的智能体 Alf 与 Bob 交朋友，Acme 有限公司是 Alf 的开发者。 它基于三条条款：Alf 与 Bob 彼此认识，若 Alice 与 Bob 是朋友（GnW: 3），则 Alf 可通过一个行为与 Bob 成为朋友；Alf 的每个行为都带有 Alice 的证明，该证明以 Alf 的公钥签署，声明 Alf 运行由其开发者 Acme 有限公司签署的代码（GAI: 2）；Acme 有限公司对 Alf 的缺陷负责，Alice 对鲁莽地操作 Alf 负责（GAI: 1）。

sents.en: The running example is Alice’s AI agent Alf befriending Bob, Acme Ltd being Alf’s developer.
sents.zh: 贯穿全文的运行示例是：Alice 的智能体 Alf 与 Bob 交朋友，Acme 有限公司是 Alf 的开发者。

sents.en: It rests on three clauses: Alf and Bob, who know each other, may become friends by an act of Alf, Alice and Bob, provided Alice and Bob are friends (GnW: 3 ); every act of Alf carries Alice’s attestation, signed over Alf’s public key, that Alf runs code signed by its developer, Acme Ltd (GAI: 2 ); Acme Ltd is accountable for Alf’s defects, and Alice for operating Alf recklessly (GAI: 1 ).
sents.zh: 它基于三条条款：Alf 与 Bob 彼此认识，若 Alice 与 Bob 是朋友（GnW: 3），则 Alf 可通过一个行为与 Bob 成为朋友；Alf 的每个行为都带有 Alice 的证明，该证明以 Alf 的公钥签署，声明 Alf 运行由其开发者 Acme 有限公司签署的代码（GAI: 2）；Acme 有限公司对 Alf 的缺陷负责，Alice 对鲁莽地操作 Alf 负责（GAI: 1）。

paragraphs.en: GnW covers both kinds of ward, AI agents and children.
paragraphs.zh: GnW 涵盖两类守护对象：AI 智能体和儿童。

paragraphs.en: An AI agent is made by a person, its developer , and is operated by its guardians, among them the person who created it, its principal . Accountability for an AI agent is divided between the two as it is for a car between its manufacturer and its driver: the manufacturer is accountable for manufacturing defects, and the driver for reckless driving. So the developer signs the code of the AI agent, and its principal attests, in a speech act signed over the AI agent’s public key, that the AI agent runs that code, and every act of the AI agent carries the attestation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个AI智能体由人，即其开发者，制造，并由其监护人运营，监护人中包括创建该智能体的人，即其委托人。 对AI智能体的责任追究在这两者之间划分，就像汽车的责任在制造商与驾驶员之间划分一样：制造商对制造缺陷负责，驾驶员对鲁莽驾驶负责。 因此，开发者对AI智能体的代码进行签名，而其委托人通过一次以AI智能体公钥签名的言语行为，证明该AI智能体运行的是那段代码，并且AI智能体的每个行为都带有该证明。

sents.en: An AI agent is made by a person, its developer , and is operated by its guardians, among them the person who created it, its principal .
sents.zh: 一个AI智能体由人，即其开发者，制造，并由其监护人运营，监护人中包括创建该智能体的人，即其委托人。

sents.en: Accountability for an AI agent is divided between the two as it is for a car between its manufacturer and its driver: the manufacturer is accountable for manufacturing defects, and the driver for reckless driving.
sents.zh: 对AI智能体的责任追究在这两者之间划分，就像汽车的责任在制造商与驾驶员之间划分一样：制造商对制造缺陷负责，驾驶员对鲁莽驾驶负责。

sents.en: So the developer signs the code of the AI agent, and its principal attests, in a speech act signed over the AI agent’s public key, that the AI agent runs that code, and every act of the AI agent carries the attestation.
sents.zh: 因此，开发者对AI智能体的代码进行签名，而其委托人通过一次以AI智能体公钥签名的言语行为，证明该AI智能体运行的是那段代码，并且AI智能体的每个行为都带有该证明。

paragraphs.en: In GAI the wards are AI agents and their guardians the persons who operate them. The principal’s will is given once, when they create the AI agent; after that the AI agent acts on its own, and a guardian takes part in each acquaintance of the AI agent and in each friendship it enters (GnW: 3 and GnW: 4 ): an AI agent comes to know an agent, and befriends one, only with a guardian. The principal signs the attestation once too, when they create the AI agent, and the AI agent presents it to each agent it comes to know, who records it (GAI: 2 ). A principal may be a legal person, so a company’s AI agents act under the company, and may make other persons guardians of an AI agent (GnW: 2 ). A guardian signs the undertaking to keep the contract for their ward ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在GAI中，被监护人是AI智能体，其监护人则是操作这些智能体的人。 委托人的意志只在创建AI智能体时给出一次；此后AI智能体自主行动，而监护人参与AI智能体的每次结识和其建立的每段友谊（GnW: 3和GnW: 4）：AI智能体只有在监护人在场的情况下才能认识某个智能体并与其结为朋友。 委托人也只在创建AI智能体时签署一次证明，AI智能体向其认识的每个智能体出示该证明，由对方记录（GAI: 2）。 委托人可以是法人，因此公司的AI智能体在公司之下行动，并且可以指定其他人员担任某个AI智能体的监护人（GnW: 2）。 监护人签署承诺书，为其被监护人保持契约（Golike et al., 2026）。

sents.en: In GAI the wards are AI agents and their guardians the persons who operate them.
sents.zh: 在GAI中，被监护人是AI智能体，其监护人则是操作这些智能体的人。

sents.zh: 监护人签署承诺书，为其被监护人保持契约（Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the contract on a person’s phone, in the GSNP app of Section 4 : a person creates an AI agent, attesting that it runs code signed by its developer, approves each acquaintance and each friendship of the AI agent, and may retire it; every agent an AI agent knows sees its principal and its developer.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了第 4 节 GSNP 应用中一个人手机上的合约：一个人创建一个 AI 智能体，证明它运行的是由其开发者签名的代码，批准该 AI 智能体的每个熟人和每段友谊关系，并可以将其退役；AI 智能体所知道的每个智能体都能看到其主体和其开发者。

paragraphs.en: The contract is realised by volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) ; the speech-act schemas of the contract (Appendix B ) determine them by the compilation of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) . We present the transactions for knowing, friendship and guardianship, of GKK, GSG, GnW and GAI, with the signing, messaging and forwarding of Section 4 ; a ward’s membership of a group, the other relation of GnW: 3 , is realised as its friendship is, by an act of the leader, the ward and its guardian, and its transactions are left out. We assume a potentially infinite set of agents Π \Pi , but consider only finite subsets of it, so when referring to a particular set of agents P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi we assume P P to be nonempty and finite; here an agent is a person or an AI agent, with its machine. We use ⊂ \subset for the strict subset relation and ⊆ \subseteq when equality is also possible, S P S^{P} for the set of all total functions from P P to S S , and c p c_{p} for the value of c ∈ S P c\in S^{P} at p ∈ P p\in P .
paragraphs.zh: 该契约由以意志为守护条件的多智能体原子事务实现（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）；契约的言语行为模式（附录 B）通过（Golike et al., 2026）的编译来确定这些事务。 我们给出 GKK、GSG、GnW 和 GAI 中关于知情、友谊与监护的事务，并附带第 4 节的签署、消息传递与转发；被监护人属于某个群体这一 GnW: 3 中的另一种关系，其实现方式与友谊相同，即由领导者、被监护人及其监护人的一项行为实现，其事务从略。 我们假设一个可能无限的智能体集合 Π \Pi，但只考虑其有限子集，因此当提及某个特定的智能体集合 P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi 时，我们假定 P P 非空且有限；这里一个智能体是一个人或一个带其机器的 AI 智能体。 我们用 ⊂ \subset 表示严格子集关系，用 ⊆ \subseteq 表示允许相等的子集关系，用 S P S^{P} 表示从 P P 到 S S 的所有全函数构成的集合，并用 c p c_{p} 表示 c ∈ S P c\in S^{P} 在 p ∈ P p\in P 处的取值。

sents.en: The contract is realised by volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) ; the speech-act schemas of the contract (Appendix B ) determine them by the compilation of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 该契约由以意志为守护条件的多智能体原子事务实现（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）；契约的言语行为模式（附录 B）通过（Golike et al., 2026）的编译来确定这些事务。

sents.en: We present the transactions for knowing, friendship and guardianship, of GKK, GSG, GnW and GAI, with the signing, messaging and forwarding of Section 4 ; a ward’s membership of a group, the other relation of GnW: 3 , is realised as its friendship is, by an act of the leader, the ward and its guardian, and its transactions are left out.
sents.zh: 我们给出 GKK、GSG、GnW 和 GAI 中关于知情、友谊与监护的事务，并附带第 4 节的签署、消息传递与转发；被监护人属于某个群体这一 GnW: 3 中的另一种关系，其实现方式与友谊相同，即由领导者、被监护人及其监护人的一项行为实现，其事务从略。

sents.en: We assume a potentially infinite set of agents Π \Pi , but consider only finite subsets of it, so when referring to a particular set of agents P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi we assume P P to be nonempty and finite; here an agent is a person or an AI agent, with its machine.
sents.zh: 我们假设一个可能无限的智能体集合 Π \Pi，但只考虑其有限子集，因此当提及某个特定的智能体集合 P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi 时，我们假定 P P 非空且有限；这里一个智能体是一个人或一个带其机器的 AI 智能体。

sents.en: We use ⊂ \subset for the strict subset relation and ⊆ \subseteq when equality is also possible, S P S^{P} for the set of all total functions from P P to S S , and c p c_{p} for the value of c ∈ S P c\in S^{P} at p ∈ P p\in P .
sents.zh: 我们用 ⊂ \subset 表示严格子集关系，用 ⊆ \subseteq 表示允许相等的子集关系，用 S P S^{P} 表示从 P P 到 S S 的所有全函数构成的集合，并用 c p c_{p} 表示 c ∈ S P c\in S^{P} 在 p ∈ P p\in P 处的取值。

paragraphs.en: Given an arbitrary set S S of machine states , with a designated initial state s 0 ∈ S s_{0}\in S , and agents Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , a machine configuration over Q Q is a member of S Q S^{Q} , and a machine transaction over participants Q Q is a pair c → c ′ ∈ ( S Q ) 2 c\rightarrow c^{\prime}\in(S^{Q})^{2} such that c ≠ c ′ c\neq c^{\prime} ; it is unary if | Q | = 1 |Q|=1 . Given such a machine transaction t t , a volition-guarded multiagent atomic transaction over t t —henceforth, volition-guarded transaction —is a pair ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) where Q ′ ⊆ Q Q^{\prime}\subseteq Q are its guards .
paragraphs.zh: 给定任意机器状态集合 S S，其中指定初始状态 s 0 ∈ S s_{0}\in S，以及智能体集合 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi，Q Q 上的机器配置是 S Q S^{Q} 的一个元素，参与者 Q Q 上的机器事务是一对 c → c ′ ∈ ( S Q ) 2 c\rightarrow c^{\prime}\in(S^{Q})^{2}，满足 c ≠ c ′ c\neq c^{\prime}；若 | Q | = 1 |Q|=1，则称其为一元的。 给定这样一个机器事务 t t，t t 上的意愿守护多智能体原子事务——以下简称意愿守护事务——是一对 ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime})，其中 Q ′ ⊆ Q Q^{\prime}\subseteq Q 是其守护者。

sents.zh: 给定这样一个机器事务 t t，t t 上的意愿守护多智能体原子事务——以下简称意愿守护事务——是一对 ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime})，其中 Q ′ ⊆ Q Q^{\prime}\subseteq Q 是其守护者。

paragraphs.en: A volition-guarded transaction can be carried out only if its guards are willing; its participants include those whose state changes and those whose state is a precondition and does not change. The rest of the framework of ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) —agent states, runs, the protocol over a set of transactions, and what makes it oblivious, interactive, grassroots and volitionally grassroots—is recalled in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 受意愿守护的事务只有在守护者愿意时才能执行；其参与者既包括状态发生改变的主体，也包括状态作为前提条件且不发生改变的主体。 (Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026) 框架的其余部分——智能体状态、运行、基于一组事务的协议，以及使其成为无感知的、交互式的、草根的和意愿性草根的条件——在附录 A 中回顾。

paragraphs.en: The local state. The speech-act schemas determine the local state of an agent p p , each component standing for the atoms of a predicate, all initially empty or zero (Table 1 , Appendix B ). An agent is a person when a p = 0 a_{p}=0 and an AI agent when a p = 1 a_{p}=1 ; the principal of an AI agent r r is the p p with ρ r = { p } \rho_{r}=\{p\} , its guardians the p p with r ∈ λ p r\in\lambda_{p} , and its attestation the y y with γ r = { y } \gamma_{r}=\{y\} . Every transaction requires ι = 1 \iota=1 at each of its participants, except Establish, and Enter at the AI agent, which require ι = 0 \iota=0 there, and θ = 0 \theta=0 at each of its guards; the transactions below leave these requirements out, and all components not explicitly updated are preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 局部状态。 这些言语行为模式确定了智能体 p 的局部状态，每个分量对应一个谓词的原子，初始时全部为空或零（表 1，附录 B）。 当 a_{p}=0 时智能体是自然人，当 a_{p}=1 时智能体是 AI 智能体；AI 智能体 r 的委托人是满足 ρ_{r}={p} 的 p，其监护人是满足 r∈λ_{p} 的 p，其证明是满足 γ_{r}={y} 的 y。 每笔交易都要求在其每个参与者处 ι=1，但 Establish 以及在 AI 智能体处的 Enter 除外，这两者在该处要求 ι=0，并且在每个守护者处要求 θ=0；下文的交易省略了这些要求，且所有未显式更新的分量均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The two transactions below realise GnW: 3 for an AI agent r r , a guardian p p of r r and a person q q whom p p knows: r r and q q come to know each other by an act of the three, q q recording r r with its attestation y y (GAI: 2 ), and then, p p and q q being friends, may become friends by an act of the three; p p may end the friendship by Agent unfriend, and each of the two friends by Unfriend (Appendix B ). The participants of each are r r , q q and p p , and each is guarded by all three.
paragraphs.zh: 以下两笔交易实现了 GnW：3，涉及一个 AI 智能体 r r、r r 的守护者 p p，以及 p p 认识的一个人 q q：三者通过一次行为使 r r 与 q q 相互认识，q q 记录 r r 及其证明 y y（GAI: 2），随后，由于 p p 与 q q 是朋友，r r 与 q q 可以通过一次三方的行为成为朋友；p p 可通过 Agent unfriend 结束该友谊，两位朋友中的每一方均可通过 Unfriend 结束该友谊（附录 B）。 每笔交易的参与者均为 r r、q q 和 p p，且每笔交易均由这三方共同守护。

paragraphs.en: For example, let Alice and Bob, a , b ∈ Π a,b\in\Pi , be persons and Alf, r ∈ Π r\in\Pi , Alice’s AI agent. Alice and Bob establish their identities, come to know each other and befriend; Alice signs y y , her attestation that Alf, by its public key, runs the code its developer signed, and creates Alf with it; Alf comes to know Bob, with Alice willing, and Bob records Alf with Alice’s attestation; Alf befriends Bob, with Alice willing; Alf signs an item x x and sends it to Bob; and Alice retires Alf, which ends Alf’s friendship with Bob. The components that change are in Table 2 (Appendix B ), Bob’s record and the item remaining with him after the friendship ends.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，设 Alice 和 Bob（其中 a , b ∈ Π a,b\in\Pi ）是个人，而 Alf（其中 r ∈ Π r\in\Pi ）是 Alice 的智能体。 Alice 和 Bob 建立各自的身份，相互认识并成为朋友；Alice 签署 y y ，即她的证明，声明 Alf 通过其公钥运行的是其开发者签署的代码，并用它创建 Alf；在 Alice 允许下，Alf 认识 Bob，Bob 记录 Alf 并附上 Alice 的证明；在 Alice 允许下，Alf 与 Bob 成为朋友；Alf 签署条目 x x 并发送给 Bob；随后 Alice 使 Alf 退役，从而终止 Alf 与 Bob 的朋友关系。 发生变化的组件见表 2（附录 B），即 Bob 的记录以及朋友关系结束后仍留存在他处的该条目。

paragraphs.en: This section states what the transactions enforce about an AI agent and its principal, with the argument for it, and that the protocol is volitionally grassroots, proved in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 本节说明了交易对 AI 智能体及其委托人所强制要求的内容及其论证理由，并说明该协议是意志上自下而上的，这一结论在附录 C 中得到证明。

paragraphs.en: Part (1) is why what the contract says of an AI agent is enforced rather than attested: an agent the contract records as an AI agent of p p cannot cease to be one by any act, its own or another’s, and part (4) is the one way it leaves. Retirement ends every guardianship and friendship of the AI agent (GnW: 5 ): the retired AI agent takes no act; the record of its principal stays, for its past acts.
paragraphs.zh: 第 (1) 部分说明了为什么合同中对 AI 智能体的记载是被强制执行而非被证明的：合同记录为属于 p p 的 AI 智能体的智能体，不能通过任何行为——无论其自身还是他人的行为——不再是 AI 智能体，而第 (4) 部分是其退出的唯一途径。 退役终止 AI 智能体的所有监护关系与友好关系（GnW: 5）：已退役的 AI 智能体不再采取任何行为；其主体的记录仍保留，用于追溯其过往行为。

paragraphs.en: Grassroots. The protocol realising the contract is volitionally grassroots (Proposition C.22 , Appendix C , by the theorem for contracts with wards proved there): two persons can always befriend, an AI agent that is not retired can always befriend a person or another AI agent with a guardian willing, and through befriending any agent can come to interact with any other; two groups that have formed apart, each with an agent that has not left, can always coalesce, and only by an act an agent of each wills. A retired AI agent has left.
paragraphs.zh: 草根性。 实现该契约的协议在意愿上是草根的（命题 C.22，附录 C，由该处证明的关于带有被监护人的契约的定理所得出）：两个人总是可以成为朋友，一个未退役的智能体在监护人愿意的情况下总是可以与一个人或另一个智能体成为朋友，并且通过成为朋友，任何智能体都能与其他任何智能体产生互动；两个各自独立形成的群体，只要每个群体中有一个未离开的智能体，就总是可以合并，且只需通过每个群体中一个智能体自愿做出的一项行为即可实现。 一个已退役的智能体已经离开。

paragraphs.en: A clause is enforced, attested or undertaken (Section 2 ) ( Golike et al., 2026 ) : no act of agents can breach an enforced clause; a breach of an attested clause leaves non-repudiable evidence against the agent in breach in another agent’s hands; and an undertaken clause is kept outside the contract, the agent’s signed undertaking to keep the contract, held by every agent they interact with, being its record, so a breach of an attested or an undertaken clause can be taken to court. The second risk of Section 1 has five parts, and we take them in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 一项条款被强制执行、被证明或被承诺（第 2 节）（Golike 等，2026）：智能体的任何行为都不得违反被强制执行的条款；违反被证明的条款会在另一智能体手中留下针对违约智能体的不可抵赖的证据；而被承诺的条款保存在合同之外，由智能体签署的遵守合同的承诺书作为其记录，由与其交互的每个智能体持有，因此违反被证明的条款或被承诺的条款都可以被诉诸法庭。 第 1 节中的第二个风险有五个部分，我们逐一讨论。

paragraphs.en: Anonymity. A person signs their acts with the private key of their genuine digital identity (GKK: 1 ); an AI agent’s key pair is chosen by its principal (GnW: 1 ), and every act of an AI agent is signed with its private key and names its principal (GAI: 2 ). Both are enforced: an agent without an identity has no act of the contract available to it, and an act of the contract is a digital speech act, an utterance signed with the key of the agent taking it ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 匿名性。 一个人用其真实数字身份（GKK：1）的私钥为其行为签名；AI 智能体的密钥对由其委托人（GnW：1）选定，AI 智能体的每一次行为都用其私钥签名，并注明其委托人（GAI：2）。 两者都得到强制执行：没有身份的智能体无法执行契约行为，而契约行为是一种数字言语行为，即由采取该行为的智能体用其密钥签名的表达（Golike and Shapiro, 2026；Golike et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Anonymity.
sents.zh: 匿名性。

sents.zh: 两者都得到强制执行：没有身份的智能体无法执行契约行为，而契约行为是一种数字言语行为，即由采取该行为的智能体用其密钥签名的表达（Golike and Shapiro, 2026；Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Masquerading as a person. An AI agent is recorded as one on its creation (GnW: 1 and GAI: 2 ), is a ward from its first act and remains one (Section 3.3 ( 1 )), and every acquaintance and every friendship of it is an act of a guardian of it (GnW: 3 and GnW: 4 ), so every agent an AI agent knows, and so every agent it interacts with, holds a record of it with its principal’s attestation, which names it as an AI agent and names its principal (Section 3.3 ( 2 )): enforced. What the contract cannot determine is whether an agent that chose its own key pair is a person: no act of the contract can tell a person’s act from a program’s taken under that person’s identity. Such a program is not an AI agent of the contract; its acts are signed with the person’s private key and are that person’s acts, for which the person is accountable (GKK: 1 ). A person’s accountability for the acts signed with their private key is undertaken: the person’s signed undertaking, held by every agent they interact with, is its record.
paragraphs.zh: 伪装成一个人。 AI 智能体在其创建时即被记录为智能体（GnW: 1 和 GAI: 2），自其首个行为起即为被监护人并保持该身份（第 3.3 节 (1)），且其每一段相识和每一段友谊都是其监护人的行为（GnW: 3 和 GnW: 4），因此它所认识的每个智能体，也就是与其交互的每个智能体，都持有附有其委托人证明的关于它的记录，该记录指明它是一个 AI 智能体并指明其委托人（第 3.3 节 (2)）：强制执行。 合同无法判定的是，一个选择了自己密钥对的智能体是否是一个人：合同的任何行为都无法区分一个人的行为与在该人身份下由程序作出的行为。 这样的程序不是该合同的 AI 智能体；其行为是以该人的私钥签署的，是该人的行为，该人对此承担责任（GKK: 1）。 一个人对以其私钥签署的行为所承担的责任是被承诺的：该人签署的承诺书，由与其交互的每个智能体持有，即为其记录。

sents.en: Masquerading as a person.
sents.zh: 伪装成一个人。

sents.en: An AI agent is recorded as one on its creation (GnW: 1 and GAI: 2 ), is a ward from its first act and remains one (Section 3.3 ( 1 )), and every acquaintance and every friendship of it is an act of a guardian of it (GnW: 3 and GnW: 4 ), so every agent an AI agent knows, and so every agent it interacts with, holds a record of it with its principal’s attestation, which names it as an AI agent and names its principal (Section 3.3 ( 2 )): enforced.
sents.zh: AI 智能体在其创建时即被记录为智能体（GnW: 1 和 GAI: 2），自其首个行为起即为被监护人并保持该身份（第 3.3 节 (1)），且其每一段相识和每一段友谊都是其监护人的行为（GnW: 3 和 GnW: 4），因此它所认识的每个智能体，也就是与其交互的每个智能体，都持有附有其委托人证明的关于它的记录，该记录指明它是一个 AI 智能体并指明其委托人（第 3.3 节 (2)）：强制执行。

sents.en: What the contract cannot determine is whether an agent that chose its own key pair is a person: no act of the contract can tell a person’s act from a program’s taken under that person’s identity.
sents.zh: 合同无法判定的是，一个选择了自己密钥对的智能体是否是一个人：合同的任何行为都无法区分一个人的行为与在该人身份下由程序作出的行为。

sents.en: Such a program is not an AI agent of the contract; its acts are signed with the person’s private key and are that person’s acts, for which the person is accountable (GKK: 1 ).
sents.zh: 这样的程序不是该合同的 AI 智能体；其行为是以该人的私钥签署的，是该人的行为，该人对此承担责任（GKK: 1）。

sents.en: A person’s accountability for the acts signed with their private key is undertaken: the person’s signed undertaking, held by every agent they interact with, is its record.
sents.zh: 一个人对以其私钥签署的行为所承担的责任是被承诺的：该人签署的承诺书，由与其交互的每个智能体持有，即为其记录。

paragraphs.en: Unknown masters. The principal of an AI agent is a person with a genuine digital identity, recorded in the AI agent and named in each of its acts, and a guardian of it, a person, takes part in each of its acquaintances and friendships (GnW: 3 , GnW: 4 and GAI: 2 ): enforced.
paragraphs.zh: 未知的主导者。 AI智能体的主导者是一个具有真实数字身份的人，该身份被记录在AI智能体中，并在其每一行为中被指明；同时，由一名监护人（一个人）参与其每一次相识与交友（GnW: 3、GnW: 4 和 GAI: 2）：强制执行。

sents.en: Unknown masters.
sents.zh: 未知的主导者。

sents.en: The principal of an AI agent is a person with a genuine digital identity, recorded in the AI agent and named in each of its acts, and a guardian of it, a person, takes part in each of its acquaintances and friendships (GnW: 3 , GnW: 4 and GAI: 2 ): enforced.
sents.zh: AI智能体的主导者是一个具有真实数字身份的人，该身份被记录在AI智能体中，并在其每一行为中被指明；同时，由一名监护人（一个人）参与其每一次相识与交友（GnW: 3、GnW: 4 和 GAI: 2）：强制执行。

paragraphs.en: Unknown goals and restraints. The contract does not determine what an AI agent is for or what its principal lets it do. It determines who is accountable for it: its developer for its defects, and every guardian of it for operating it recklessly (GAI: 1 ). The clause is undertaken, each guardian’s signed undertaking being held by every agent they interact with. GAI: 2 is enforced: the principal signs the attestation when they create the AI agent, and every act of the AI agent carries it, every agent the AI agent knows holding it (Section 3.3 ( 1 ) and ( 2 )). The attestation does not establish what code the AI agent runs; an attestation of code the AI agent does not run is evidence against the principal that they cannot repudiate.
paragraphs.zh: 目标与约束不明。 合同并不决定 AI 智能体用于什么用途，也不决定其委托人允许它做什么。 合同决定的是谁对它承担责任：其开发者对它的缺陷负责，而它的每一位监护人对鲁莽地运行它的行为负责（GAI: 1）。 该条款是被承诺遵守的，每位监护人所签署的承诺书由与其交互的每一个智能体持有。 执行 GAI: 2：委托人在创建 AI 智能体时签署证明声明，AI 智能体的每一个行为都携带该声明，AI 智能体所知晓的每一个智能体都持有它（第 3.3 节第（1）款和第（2）款）。 证明声明并不能确定 AI 智能体运行的是什么代码；一份关于 AI 智能体并未运行的代码的证明声明，是对委托人不利且其无法抵赖的证据。

sents.en: Unknown goals and restraints.
sents.zh: 目标与约束不明。

sents.en: The contract does not determine what an AI agent is for or what its principal lets it do.
sents.zh: 合同并不决定 AI 智能体用于什么用途，也不决定其委托人允许它做什么。

sents.en: It determines who is accountable for it: its developer for its defects, and every guardian of it for operating it recklessly (GAI: 1 ).
sents.zh: 合同决定的是谁对它承担责任：其开发者对它的缺陷负责，而它的每一位监护人对鲁莽地运行它的行为负责（GAI: 1）。

sents.en: The clause is undertaken, each guardian’s signed undertaking being held by every agent they interact with.
sents.zh: 该条款是被承诺遵守的，每位监护人所签署的承诺书由与其交互的每一个智能体持有。

sents.en: GAI: 2 is enforced: the principal signs the attestation when they create the AI agent, and every act of the AI agent carries it, every agent the AI agent knows holding it (Section 3.3 ( 1 ) and ( 2 )).
sents.zh: 执行 GAI: 2：委托人在创建 AI 智能体时签署证明声明，AI 智能体的每一个行为都携带该声明，AI 智能体所知晓的每一个智能体都持有它（第 3.3 节第（1）款和第（2）款）。

sents.en: The attestation does not establish what code the AI agent runs; an attestation of code the AI agent does not run is evidence against the principal that they cannot repudiate.
sents.zh: 证明声明并不能确定 AI 智能体运行的是什么代码；一份关于 AI 智能体并未运行的代码的证明声明，是对委托人不利且其无法抵赖的证据。

paragraphs.en: Accountability and culpability. Every act of an AI agent is signed with its key, names its principal and carries its principal’s attestation (GAI: 2 ), and the agent it is addressed to holds it: non-repudiable evidence attributing the act to the AI agent and the AI agent to its principal ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) . Harm done by an AI agent under this contract is harm done by an identified agent, whose guardians are accountable for operating it recklessly and whose developer is accountable for its defects (GAI: 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 问责与责任追究。 智能体的每一个行为都以其密钥签名，注明其委托人并携带委托人的证明（GAI: 2），而该行为所发送至的智能体持有它：这是不可抵赖的证据，将行为归属于该智能体，并将该智能体归属于其委托人（Golike and Shapiro, 2026）。 智能体在此契约下造成的损害，是由一个可识别的智能体造成的，其监护人因鲁莽地运行该智能体而承担问责，其开发者则因该智能体的缺陷而承担问责（GAI: 1）。

sents.en: Accountability and culpability.
sents.zh: 问责与责任追究。

sents.en: Every act of an AI agent is signed with its key, names its principal and carries its principal’s attestation (GAI: 2 ), and the agent it is addressed to holds it: non-repudiable evidence attributing the act to the AI agent and the AI agent to its principal ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 智能体的每一个行为都以其密钥签名，注明其委托人并携带委托人的证明（GAI: 2），而该行为所发送至的智能体持有它：这是不可抵赖的证据，将行为归属于该智能体，并将该智能体归属于其委托人（Golike and Shapiro, 2026）。

sents.en: Harm done by an AI agent under this contract is harm done by an identified agent, whose guardians are accountable for operating it recklessly and whose developer is accountable for its defects (GAI: 1 ).
sents.zh: 智能体在此契约下造成的损害，是由一个可识别的智能体造成的，其监护人因鲁莽地运行该智能体而承担问责，其开发者则因该智能体的缺陷而承担问责（GAI: 1）。

paragraphs.en: Hence on a platform realising this contract there are no anonymous agents, natural or computational, and so there are no anonymous AI agents: an AI agent acts under an identity of its own, recorded as an AI agent and naming its principal, or a program acts under a person’s identity and that person is accountable for its acts.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在一个实现此契约的平台上，不存在匿名智能体——无论是自然人还是计算实体，因此也不存在匿名的人工智能智能体：人工智能智能体以其自身的身份行事，该身份被记录为人工智能智能体并指明其委托人；或者，程序以某个人的身份行事，而该人须对其行为负责。

paragraphs.en: This section extends the contract of Section 3 by GSNP, the grassroots social network with provenance ( Shapiro, 2023b ) , which extends GSN (Section 2.3 ) by one clause: an agent may send an item they received from a friend to another friend, adding their signature to the signatures the item has. It then shows which parts of the third risk of Section 1 the contract excludes and which it makes answerable. An item is a speech act: content signed by its author ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) , and, when forwarded, signed over by each agent that forwarded it, in order. GSNP’s speech-act schemas are in the repository, and the protocol realising it is volitionally grassroots (Proposition C.21 , Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节通过 GSNP（具有溯源机制的草根社交网络）（Shapiro, 2023b）扩展第 3 节的契约，GSNP 在 GSN（第 2.3 节）的基础上增加了一条条款：智能体可以将其从某位朋友处收到的条目转发给另一位朋友，并在该条目已有的签名之上追加自己的签名。 随后，本文说明该契约排除了第 1 节第三类风险的哪些部分，又使哪些部分变得可问责。 条目是一种言语行为：由其作者签名的内容（Golike and Shapiro, 2026），并且当被转发时，由每个转发该条目的智能体按顺序依次加签。 GSNP 的言语行为模式存放在代码仓库中，实现该协议的协议在意志上是草根的（命题 C.21，附录 C）。

sents.zh: 本节通过 GSNP（具有溯源机制的草根社交网络）（Shapiro, 2023b）扩展第 3 节的契约，GSNP 在 GSN（第 2.3 节）的基础上增加了一条条款：智能体可以将其从某位朋友处收到的条目转发给另一位朋友，并在该条目已有的签名之上追加自己的签名。

sents.en: It then shows which parts of the third risk of Section 1 the contract excludes and which it makes answerable.
sents.zh: 随后，本文说明该契约排除了第 1 节第三类风险的哪些部分，又使哪些部分变得可问责。

sents.en: An item is a speech act: content signed by its author ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) , and, when forwarded, signed over by each agent that forwarded it, in order.
sents.zh: 条目是一种言语行为：由其作者签名的内容（Golike and Shapiro, 2026），并且当被转发时，由每个转发该条目的智能体按顺序依次加签。

sents.en: GSNP’s speech-act schemas are in the repository, and the protocol realising it is volitionally grassroots (Proposition C.21 , Appendix C ).
sents.zh: GSNP 的言语行为模式存放在代码仓库中，实现该协议的协议在意志上是草根的（命题 C.21，附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: GSNP adds provenance to the messages of GSN: a message to a friend (GSN: 1 ) or to a group (GSN: 4 ) carries an item. An agent signs the content they create, as they sign every act (GKK: 1 ): signing adds the item to its author’s holdings; a message carries an item its sender authored, as they signed it; forwarding adds to the friend’s holdings an item the forwarder received, signed over by the forwarder (GSNP: 1 ); and a leader delivers a member’s item to the group by forwarding it, signed over by the leader; so an item in an agent’s hands is signed by its author and by every agent that forwarded it, in order, and carries its provenance inside it. Alice may remove the signatures of an item with other software and send the result as their own; the item then carries Alice’s signature, which is evidence of the breach. An agent holds an item by signing it or by receiving it from a friend, the leader of a group being a friend of each of its members (GSN: 3 ), and in no other way: content that reaches a person otherwise is not an item of the platform. Accountability for the items of an AI agent is as in GAI: 1 .
paragraphs.zh: GSNP 为 GSN 的消息添加了出处：发给朋友的消息（GSN：1）或发给群组的消息（GSN：4）携带一个条目。 智能体对其创建的内容进行签名，就像对每一个行为进行签名一样（GKK：1）：签名将该条目加入其作者的持有物中；一条消息携带其发送者所创作的条目，因为发送者对其进行了签名；转发则将转发者所收到的、由转发者签名转让的条目加入朋友的持有物中（GSNP：1）；而领导者通过转发将成员的条目传递给群组，由领导者签名转让；因此，智能体手中的条目由其作者以及依顺序转发它的每个智能体签名，并且其出处包含在条目自身之中。 Alice 可以用其他软件去除某个条目的签名，并将结果作为自己的内容发送；此时该条目携带的是 Alice 的签名，这就是违规行为的证据。 智能体通过签署某个条目或从朋友那里接收它来持有该条目，而群组的领导者是其每个成员的朋友（GSN：3），除此之外别无他法：以其他方式到达某人的内容不属于该平台的条目。 对 AI 智能体的条目的问责与 GAI：1 中所述相同。

sents.zh: GSNP 为 GSN 的消息添加了出处：发给朋友的消息（GSN：1）或发给群组的消息（GSN：4）携带一个条目。

sents.zh: 对 AI 智能体的条目的问责与 GAI：1 中所述相同。

paragraphs.en: The GSNP app is the GSN app with provenance and with the AI agents of Section 3 (Figure 5 ): every item shows its author and every agent that forwarded it (GSNP: 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: GSNP 应用是带有出处信息以及第 3 节所述 AI 智能体的 GSN 应用（图 5）：每个条目都会显示其作者以及转发过它的每个智能体（GSNP：1）。

paragraphs.en: The third risk of Section 1 has three parts, and we take them in turn, with the three modalities of Section 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 节中的第三个风险包含三个部分，我们依次进行讨论，并结合第 3.4 节中的三种模态。

paragraphs.en: Anonymous content. Every item is signed by its author, an agent with a genuine digital identity who signs every act with their private key (GKK: 1 ), and an agent holds an item only by signing it or by receiving it from a friend, who authored it or signed it over (GSNP: 1 ): enforced. Every item an agent holds carries the signatures of its author and of each agent it passed through, and content signed by nobody is not an item of the platform. Whether the content was produced by a person or by an AI is not what the signatures say; who is accountable for it is.
paragraphs.zh: 匿名内容。 每一条内容都由其作者签名，作者是拥有真实数字身份的智能体，其每一个行为都使用自己的私钥签名（GKK: 1），并且智能体只有通过亲自签名或从好友那里接收某条内容才持有该内容，好友可以是该内容的作者或已将其签名转让（GSNP: 1）：已强制执行。 智能体持有的每一条内容都带有其作者以及它所经过的每个智能体的签名，无人签名的内容不属于本平台的内容。 签名所表明的并不是内容是由人还是由 AI 生成的，而是谁对该内容负责。

sents.en: Anonymous content.
sents.zh: 匿名内容。

sents.en: Every item is signed by its author, an agent with a genuine digital identity who signs every act with their private key (GKK: 1 ), and an agent holds an item only by signing it or by receiving it from a friend, who authored it or signed it over (GSNP: 1 ): enforced.
sents.zh: 每一条内容都由其作者签名，作者是拥有真实数字身份的智能体，其每一个行为都使用自己的私钥签名（GKK: 1），并且智能体只有通过亲自签名或从好友那里接收某条内容才持有该内容，好友可以是该内容的作者或已将其签名转让（GSNP: 1）：已强制执行。

sents.en: Every item an agent holds carries the signatures of its author and of each agent it passed through, and content signed by nobody is not an item of the platform.
sents.zh: 智能体持有的每一条内容都带有其作者以及它所经过的每个智能体的签名，无人签名的内容不属于本平台的内容。

sents.en: Whether the content was produced by a person or by an AI is not what the signatures say; who is accountable for it is.
sents.zh: 签名所表明的并不是内容是由人还是由 AI 生成的，而是谁对该内容负责。

paragraphs.en: Content people cannot tell from genuine content. The platform does not decide whether content is synthetic; it decides who signed it. An item authored by an AI agent is signed by the AI agent, which every agent it knows holds recorded as an AI agent of its principal (GnW: 3 and GAI: 2 ): a reader who knows the AI agent sees that the item is an AI agent’s and whose; enforced. A reader who does not know the AI agent sees its signature and the forwarders’, each of whom received it from a friend (GSNP: 1 ). An item a person signs is that person’s, whatever produced it, and the person is accountable for it (GKK: 1 ): a person who signs AI-generated content as their own is its author. An item that purports to be a person’s and is not carries that person’s signature or it does not, and a signature cannot be forged ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) ; an item that depicts or quotes a person is its author’s statement about them, and the author is accountable for it. So a reader of a grassroots social network tells content with provenance from the rest by its signatures, which every item carries, and not by its look.
paragraphs.zh: 让人们无法从内容本身分辨真假内容。 平台并不判断内容是否为合成内容；它只判断内容是谁签署的。 由AI智能体创作的内容由该AI智能体签署，而它所知道的每个智能体都将其记录为所属主体名下的AI智能体（GnW: 3 以及 GAI: 2）：了解该AI智能体的读者即可看出该内容属于某个AI智能体、属于哪一个，且这是强制执行的。 不了解该AI智能体的读者则能看到它的签名以及各转发者的签名，其中每个转发者都是从朋友那里收到该内容的（GSNP: 1）。 由某人签署的内容即为该人的内容，无论其由什么生成，且该人对此负责（GKK: 1）：将AI生成内容以自己名义签署的人就是该内容的作者。 声称属于某人而实际不属于的内容，要么带有该人的签名，要么不带，而签名是无法伪造的（Golike and Shapiro, 2026）；描绘或引用某人的内容是作者关于该人的陈述，作者对此负责。 因此，草根社交网络的读者通过签名——每条内容都带有签名——来区分有来源信息的内容与其他内容，而不是通过外观。

sents.en: Content people cannot tell from genuine content.
sents.zh: 让人们无法从内容本身分辨真假内容。

sents.en: The platform does not decide whether content is synthetic; it decides who signed it.
sents.zh: 平台并不判断内容是否为合成内容；它只判断内容是谁签署的。

sents.en: An item authored by an AI agent is signed by the AI agent, which every agent it knows holds recorded as an AI agent of its principal (GnW: 3 and GAI: 2 ): a reader who knows the AI agent sees that the item is an AI agent’s and whose; enforced.
sents.zh: 由AI智能体创作的内容由该AI智能体签署，而它所知道的每个智能体都将其记录为所属主体名下的AI智能体（GnW: 3 以及 GAI: 2）：了解该AI智能体的读者即可看出该内容属于某个AI智能体、属于哪一个，且这是强制执行的。

sents.en: A reader who does not know the AI agent sees its signature and the forwarders’, each of whom received it from a friend (GSNP: 1 ).
sents.zh: 不了解该AI智能体的读者则能看到它的签名以及各转发者的签名，其中每个转发者都是从朋友那里收到该内容的（GSNP: 1）。

sents.en: An item a person signs is that person’s, whatever produced it, and the person is accountable for it (GKK: 1 ): a person who signs AI-generated content as their own is its author.
sents.zh: 由某人签署的内容即为该人的内容，无论其由什么生成，且该人对此负责（GKK: 1）：将AI生成内容以自己名义签署的人就是该内容的作者。

sents.en: An item that purports to be a person’s and is not carries that person’s signature or it does not, and a signature cannot be forged ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) ; an item that depicts or quotes a person is its author’s statement about them, and the author is accountable for it.
sents.zh: 声称属于某人而实际不属于的内容，要么带有该人的签名，要么不带，而签名是无法伪造的（Golike and Shapiro, 2026）；描绘或引用某人的内容是作者关于该人的陈述，作者对此负责。

sents.en: So a reader of a grassroots social network tells content with provenance from the rest by its signatures, which every item carries, and not by its look.
sents.zh: 因此，草根社交网络的读者通过签名——每条内容都带有签名——来区分有来源信息的内容与其他内容，而不是通过外观。

paragraphs.en: Producers evading accountability. The signature of an item is non-repudiable evidence that its author produced it, held by every agent that holds the item, and each forwarder’s signature over it is evidence that they passed it on: attested (GSNP: 1 ). An agent who removes the signatures of an item they received and sends the result as their own breaches GSNP: 1 , and the item they sent, signed by them, is the evidence ( Golike et al., 2026 ) . The author of an item, a person or an AI agent with an accountable developer and principal (GAI: 1 ), and each agent that forwarded it, are identified agents, and harm done by an item can be taken to court against them ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ; Golike et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 生产者逃避责任。 物品的签名是其作者生产该物品的不可否认证据，由持有该物品的每个智能体持有，且每个转发者在其上的签名是它们转发了该物品的证据：已证明（GSNP: 1）。 智能体移除其收到的物品的签名并将结果作为自己的物品发送，即违反 GSNP: 1，而其发送的、由其签名的物品就是证据（Golike et al., 2026）。 物品的作者——即一个人或拥有可问责开发者与委托人的 AI 智能体（GAI: 1）——以及转发该物品的每个智能体，都是已识别的智能体，物品造成的伤害可以对他们提起诉讼（Golike and Shapiro, 2026; Golike et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Hence on a platform realising this contract there is no anonymous content: every item carries the signatures of its author, a person accountable for it or an AI agent whose principal and developer are accountable for it, and of every agent that forwarded it. Deepfake content may be produced outside the platform and signed into it, and it then has an author who is accountable for it; what the platform does not carry is content with no one behind it.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在实现此契约的平台上不存在匿名内容：每个条目都带有其作者的签名，即对该内容负责的人，或其委托人和开发者对其负责的智能体（AI 智能体）的签名，以及转发该内容的每个智能体的签名。 深度伪造内容可能在平台之外制作并被签名进入平台，此时它有一位对其负责的作者；平台不承载的是背后没有任何人的内容。

paragraphs.en: AI risks. Taxonomies and surveys of AI risks include those of Weidinger et al. ( Weidinger et al., 2022 ) , Bommasani et al. ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ) and Hendrycks et al. ( Hendrycks et al., 2023 ) , the AI Risk Repository ( Slattery et al., 2026 ) and the International AI Safety Report ( Bengio et al., 2026 ) . Algorithmic governance and regulation ( Danaher et al., 2017 ; Yeung, 2018 ) and gradual disempowerment ( Kulveit et al., 2025 ) bear on the first risk; personhood credentials ( Adler et al., 2024 ) , social bots ( Ferrara et al., 2016 ) , visibility into AI agents ( Chan et al., 2024 ) , the governance of agentic systems ( Shavit et al., 2023 ) , moral crumple zones ( Elish, 2019 ) and meaningful human control ( Santoni de Sio and van den Hoven, 2018 ) on the second; deepfakes ( Chesney and Citron, 2019 ; Mirsky and Lee, 2021 ; Nightingale and Farid, 2022 ; Vaccari and Chadwick, 2020 ) and reducing the risks of synthetic content ( Chandra et al., 2024 ) on the third; and AI assistants ( Gabriel et al., 2024 ) , chatbot use ( Fang et al., 2025 ) and malicious use ( Brundage et al., 2018 ; Marchal et al., 2024 ) on the two risks not addressed here. We address the three through the organisation of the platform.

paragraphs.en: Grassroots platforms. Grassroots platforms ( Shapiro, 2023a ; Shapiro, 2024 ) are characterised against global platforms, centralised, decentralised and federated ( Shapiro, 2025a ) , the decentralised ones exemplified by Bitcoin ( Nakamoto, 2008 ) and Ethereum ( Wood and others, 2014 ) . They are specified by atomic transactions ( Shapiro, 2026c ) and volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) , and defined by grassroots contracts ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , digital social contracts ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ) meeting Proudhon’s conditions ( Proudhon and Robinson, 2004 ) . Their instances include grassroots social networks ( Shapiro, 2023b ) , currencies ( Shapiro, 2022 ) and bonds ( Shapiro, 2026b ) , and a child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) . Their identities are genuine personal identifiers ( Shahaf et al., 2020 ) , their communities grow sybil-resiliently ( Poupko et al., 2021 ) , their content is digital speech acts ( Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) , and their participants recover from the loss or compromise of a key or a device with the help of their friends ( Eitan et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 草根平台。 草根平台（Shapiro, 2023a；Shapiro, 2024）是与全球平台、中心化、去中心化和联邦式平台（Shapiro, 2025a）相对而言的，其中去中心化平台的代表是比特币（Nakamoto, 2008）和以太坊（Wood and others, 2014）。 它们由原子交易（Shapiro, 2026c）和由意志守护的多智能体原子交易（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）加以规定，并由草根合约（Golike et al., 2026）——即满足蒲鲁东条件（Proudhon and Robinson, 2004）的数字社会契约（Cardelli et al., 2020）——加以定义。 它们的实例包括草根社交网络（Shapiro, 2023b）、货币（Shapiro, 2022）和债券（Shapiro, 2026b），以及一个儿童安全的社交网络（Shapiro, 2026a）。 它们的身份是真正的个人标识符（Shahaf et al., 2020），它们的社区以抗女巫攻击的方式增长（Poupko et al., 2021），它们的内容是数字言语行为（Golike and Shapiro, 2026），并且它们的参与者可以借助朋友的帮助从密钥或设备的丢失或失窃中恢复（Eitan et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: The cascade. A contract is compiled down to a phone through volition elicitation and vGLP ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) , Grassroots Logic Programs ( Shapiro, 2025b ) , their types ( Shapiro, 2026g ) and their implementation ( Shapiro, 2026d ) , and the Grassroots Super-App ( Eitan et al., 2026b ) , in which each platform is a mini-app.
paragraphs.zh: 这个级联。 一份合约通过意志引出与 vGLP（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）、 grassroots 逻辑程序（Shapiro, 2025b）、其类型（Shapiro, 2026g）及其实现（Shapiro, 2026d），以及 Grassroots 超级应用（Eitan et al., 2026b）——其中每个平台都是一个迷你应用——最终编译部署到手机上。

paragraphs.en: Person-to-person systems. Two deployed systems share the person-to-person architecture of grassroots platforms. In Secure Scuttlebutt ( Tarr et al., 2019 ) each participant publishes to a single-writer, append-only log and replicates the logs of the identities they choose, so data flows along the edges of a social graph, as in grassroots social networks ( Shapiro, 2023b ) . Briar ( Briar Project, 2018 ) synchronises messages directly between its users’ devices, with no central server, and over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi when the Internet is down. Both are classified as grassroots by their essential agents, informally ( Shapiro, 2025a ) . Local-first software ( Kleppmann et al., 2019 ) keeps the primary copy of a person’s data on their own devices, with servers holding secondary copies, and merges concurrent changes by conflict-free replicated data types that sync over any channel, a peer-to-peer connection included; in a grassroots platform, the copies of a person’s state are held by the state custodians they designate among their friends ( Eitan et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人对人的系统。 两个已部署的系统共享草根平台的人对人架构。 在 Secure Scuttlebutt（Tarr 等人，2019）中，每个参与者发布到一个单写者、只追加的日志，并复制其所选身份的日志，因此数据沿着社交图的边流动，正如草根社交网络那样（Shapiro，2023b）。 Briar（Briar Project，2018）在其用户的设备之间直接同步消息，没有中心服务器，并且在互联网中断时可通过蓝牙或 Wi-Fi 进行同步。 按照其本质智能体，两者都被非正式地归类为草根系统（Shapiro，2025a）。 本地优先软件（Kleppmann 等人，2019）将个人数据的主副本保存在其自己的设备上，服务器持有副本，并通过无冲突复制数据类型合并并发更改，这些数据类型可通过任何通道同步，包括点对点连接；在草根平台中，个人状态的副本由其在朋友中指定的状态保管者持有（Eitan 等人，2026a）。
