paragraphs.en: Grassroots platforms corral three AI risks of digital platforms. A grassroots platform has no part whose capture is control of it, so to control it an AI must control the smartphones of its participants, one by one. Under the contract of Section 3 , every AI agent has a principal and a developer, every act of an AI agent names its principal and carries its principal’s attestation that it runs code signed by its developer, and its guardians and its developer are accountable for it. Under the contract of Section 4 , every item carries the signatures of its author and of every agent that forwarded it.
paragraphs.zh: 草根平台规避了数字平台的三大人工智能风险。 草根平台没有任何可以被夺取后就等于控制了它的部分，因此要控制它，人工智能必须逐一控制其参与者的智能手机。 根据第 3 节的契约，每个人工智能体都有委托人和开发者，人工智能体的每个行为都会注明其委托人，并携带其委托人的证明，表明其运行的是由其开发者签名的代码，而且其监护人和开发者要为其负责。 根据第 4 节的契约，每个条目都带有其作者以及转发它的每个智能体的签名。

sents.en: Grassroots platforms corral three AI risks of digital platforms.
sents.zh: 草根平台规避了数字平台的三大人工智能风险。

sents.en: A grassroots platform has no part whose capture is control of it, so to control it an AI must control the smartphones of its participants, one by one.
sents.zh: 草根平台没有任何可以被夺取后就等于控制了它的部分，因此要控制它，人工智能必须逐一控制其参与者的智能手机。

sents.en: Under the contract of Section 3 , every AI agent has a principal and a developer, every act of an AI agent names its principal and carries its principal’s attestation that it runs code signed by its developer, and its guardians and its developer are accountable for it.
sents.zh: 根据第 3 节的契约，每个人工智能体都有委托人和开发者，人工智能体的每个行为都会注明其委托人，并携带其委托人的证明，表明其运行的是由其开发者签名的代码，而且其监护人和开发者要为其负责。

sents.en: Under the contract of Section 4 , every item carries the signatures of its author and of every agent that forwarded it.
sents.zh: 根据第 4 节的契约，每个条目都带有其作者以及转发它的每个智能体的签名。

paragraphs.en: This appendix recalls, in the words of ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) , the mathematical foundations on which the paper is based; the proofs of the results recalled are in that paper.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录以（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）的措辞回顾了本文所依赖的数学基础；所回顾结果的证明见于该论文。

paragraphs.en: Each agent consists of a person and a machine (e.g., smartphone) operated by the person. A machine transaction specifies what machines do; a volition guard specifies which persons must be willing for the transaction to occur.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体由一个人和该人所操作的一台机器（例如智能手机）组成。 机器交易规定机器做什么；意愿守卫规定交易发生时哪些人必须愿意。

paragraphs.en: Machine states, configurations, machine transactions, and volition-guarded transactions are as in Definition 3.1 (Section 3.2 ), which also recalls the reading of guards and of the unguarded case.

paragraphs.en: Distinct machine transactions can represent “the same action” in different configurations; this is captured with an equivalence relation on machine transactions.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的机器事务可以在不同配置中表示“同一动作”；这一点通过机器事务上的等价关系来刻画。

paragraphs.en: A person’s not willing a transaction has, so far, no consequence: no volitional transaction is enabled by the absence of a will. An implementation of volition-guarded transactions by communicating agents ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) needs one, so that a machine asked for its person’s will answers either way; it is the following, by which the machine answers for a person who does not will an act: in machine state s s , if p p wills it s ′ s^{\prime} is taken, else s ′′ s^{\prime\prime} .
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，一个人不愿意进行某项交易并没有任何后果：意愿的缺失不会使任何意志性交易得以进行。 由通信智能体实现的意志守护交易（Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）需要这一概念，使得被询问其当事人意愿的机器无论如何都能作出回答；机器为不愿实施某行为的人作答的方式如下：在机器状态 s s 中，若 p p 意愿该行为则采纳 s′ s^{\prime}，否则采纳 s″ s^{\prime\prime}。

sents.en: An implementation of volition-guarded transactions by communicating agents ( Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) needs one, so that a machine asked for its person’s will answers either way; it is the following, by which the machine answers for a person who does not will an act: in machine state s s , if p p wills it s ′ s^{\prime} is taken, else s ′′ s^{\prime\prime} .

paragraphs.en: Given machine states S S , a volition-guarded if-then-else transaction over a single participant p ∈ Π p\in\Pi is a triple s → s ′ ; s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\,;\,s^{\prime\prime} guarded by p p , with s , s ′ , s ′′ ∈ S s,s^{\prime},s^{\prime\prime}\in S , s ≠ s ′ s\neq s^{\prime} and s ≠ s ′′ s\neq s^{\prime\prime} ; the unary machine transaction s → s ′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime} is its then-branch and s → s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime\prime} its else-branch .
paragraphs.zh: 给定机器状态 S S，定义在单个参与者 p ∈ Π p\in\Pi 上的意志保护 if-then-else 事务是一个三元组 s → s ′ ; s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\,;\,s^{\prime\prime}，由 p p 保护，其中 s , s ′ , s ′′ ∈ S s,s^{\prime},s^{\prime\prime}\in S，s ≠ s ′ s\neq s^{\prime} 且 s ≠ s ′′ s\neq s^{\prime\prime}；一元机器事务 s → s ′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime} 是其 then 分支，而 s → s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime\prime} 是其 else 分支。

paragraphs.en: Given agents P P , states S S , machine transactions T T over P P and S S , and equivalence ∼ \sim on T T , an else transaction induced by a volition-guarded if-then-else transaction s → s ′ ; s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\,;\,s^{\prime\prime} guarded by p ∈ P p\in P , with s → s ′ ∈ T s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\in T , is a pair c → c ′ c\rightarrow c^{\prime} of agent configurations over P P , S S , T T , and ∼ \sim such that [ s → s ′ ] ∉ c p v [s\rightarrow s^{\prime}]\notin c^{v}_{p} ; c p m = s c^{m}_{p}=s and c ′ m p = s ′′ c^{\prime}{{}^{m}_{p}}=s^{\prime\prime} ; c m q = c ′ m q c^{m}_{q}=c^{\prime}{{}^{m}_{q}} for every q ∈ P ∖ { p } q\in P\setminus\{p\} ; and c ′ v q = c v q c^{\prime}{{}^{v}_{q}}=c^{v}_{q} for every q ∈ P q\in P .
paragraphs.zh: 给定智能体集合 P P、状态集合 S S、作用于 P P 和 S S 的机器迁移 T T，以及 T T 上的等价关系 ∼ \sim，由一个受意志守护的 if-then-else 迁移 s → s ′ ; s ′′ s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\,;\,s^{\prime\prime}（其守护者为 p ∈ P p\in P，且 s → s ′ ∈ T s\rightarrow s^{\prime}\in T）所诱导的 else 迁移，是一个由 P P、S S、T T 和 ∼ \sim 上的智能体构型组成的对 c → c ′ c\rightarrow c^{\prime}，使得：[ s → s ′ ] ∉ c p v [s\rightarrow s^{\prime}]\notin c^{v}_{p}；c p m = s c^{m}_{p}=s 且 c ′ m p = s ′′ c^{\prime}{{}^{m}_{p}}=s^{\prime\prime}；对每个 q ∈ P ∖ { p } q\in P\setminus\{p\}，有 c m q = c ′ m q c^{m}_{q}=c^{\prime}{{}^{m}_{q}}；且对每个 q ∈ P q\in P，有 c ′ v q = c v q c^{\prime}{{}^{v}_{q}}=c^{v}_{q}。

paragraphs.en: The then-branch, taken when p p wills it, is the unary volition-guarded transaction ( s → s ′ , { p } ) (s\rightarrow s^{\prime},\{p\}) and induces volitional machine transactions per Definition A.3 ; a unary volition-guarded transaction is thus the special case with no else-branch. The else transaction is taken when p p does not will the then-branch; it fulfils no will and removes no class. The two are placed in one class below, so that liveness obliges the machine to answer either way; the obligation is the machine’s, and it has no time bound. Only a unary transaction has an else-branch: a binary one would let an agent that never wills it trigger it.
paragraphs.zh: 当 p 愿意时走 then 分支，即一元意志守卫事务 (s→s′,{p})，并按定义 A.3 引发意志性机器事务；因此一元意志守卫事务就是没有 else 分支的特殊情形。 当 p 不愿意走 then 分支时走 else 事务；它不实现任何意愿，也不移除任何类。 下面把二者置于同一个类中，使活性要求机器无论哪种方式都必须作出回应；该义务属于机器，且没有时间界限。 只有一元事务才有 else 分支：二元事务会让一个从不意愿它的智能体触发它。

sents.en: The then-branch, taken when p p wills it, is the unary volition-guarded transaction ( s → s ′ , { p } ) (s\rightarrow s^{\prime},\{p\}) and induces volitional machine transactions per Definition A.3 ; a unary volition-guarded transaction is thus the special case with no else-branch.
sents.zh: 当 p 愿意时走 then 分支，即一元意志守卫事务 (s→s′,{p})，并按定义 A.3 引发意志性机器事务；因此一元意志守卫事务就是没有 else 分支的特殊情形。

sents.en: The else transaction is taken when p p does not will the then-branch; it fulfils no will and removes no class.
sents.zh: 当 p 不愿意走 then 分支时走 else 事务；它不实现任何意愿，也不移除任何类。

sents.en: The two are placed in one class below, so that liveness obliges the machine to answer either way; the obligation is the machine’s, and it has no time bound.
sents.zh: 下面把二者置于同一个类中，使活性要求机器无论哪种方式都必须作出回应；该义务属于机器，且没有时间界限。

sents.en: Only a unary transaction has an else-branch: a binary one would let an agent that never wills it trigger it.
sents.zh: 只有一元事务才有 else 分支：二元事务会让一个从不意愿它的智能体触发它。

paragraphs.en: Induced transition systems. The following is a simplified variation, sufficient for the purpose of this work, on the foundations introduced in ( Shapiro, 2021 ) .

sents.en: Induced transition systems.
sents.zh: 归约转移系统。

sents.en: The following is a simplified variation, sufficient for the purpose of this work, on the foundations introduced in ( Shapiro, 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 以下是对（Shapiro, 2021）中提出的基础内容的一个简化变体，足以满足本工作的目的。

paragraphs.en: A transition system is a tuple T S = ( S , s 0 , T , ∼ ) TS=(S,s_{0},T,{\sim}) , where:
paragraphs.zh: 转换系统是一个元组 T S = ( S , s 0 , T , ∼ ) TS=(S,s_{0},T,{\sim}) ，其中：

paragraphs.en: S S is an arbitrary non-empty set, referred to as the set of states .
paragraphs.zh: S S 是一个任意的非空集合，称为状态集。

paragraphs.en: Some s 0 ∈ S s_{0}\in S is the designated initial state .
paragraphs.zh: 某 s_{0}\in S 是被指定的初始状态。

paragraphs.en: T ⊆ S 2 T\subseteq S^{2} is a set of correct transitions over S S , where each transition t ∈ T t\in T is a pair ( s , s ′ ) (s,s^{\prime}) of non-identical states s ≠ s ′ ∈ S s\neq s^{\prime}\in S , also written as t = s → s ′ t=s\rightarrow s^{\prime} .
paragraphs.zh: T ⊆ S 2 T\subseteq S^{2} 是定义在 S S 上的正确转移的集合，其中每个转移 t ∈ T t\in T 是由两个不相同的状态组成的一对 ( s , s ′ ) (s,s^{\prime}) ，即 s ≠ s ′ ∈ S s\neq s^{\prime}\in S ，也可写作 t = s → s ′ t=s\rightarrow s^{\prime} 。

paragraphs.en: ∼ \sim is a partial equivalence relation on T T : a symmetric and transitive relation on T T , not necessarily reflexive. Its domain { t ∈ T : t ∼ t } \{t\in T:t\sim t\} is partitioned into countably many liveness classes T / ∼ T/{\sim} ; a transition outside the domain belongs to no class.
paragraphs.zh: ∼ 是 T 上的偏等价关系：即 T 上满足对称性和传递性的关系，但不一定满足自反性。 其定义域 {t ∈ T : t ∼ t} 被划分为可数多个活性类 T/∼；定义域之外的变迁不属于任何类。

A run r r is live if no class [ t ] ∈ T / ∼ [t]\in T/{\sim} is enabled in every state of some suffix of r r with no member of [ t ] [t] occurring in the suffix. A run is correct if it is safe and live.

sents.zh: 一个运行是正确的，如果它既是安全的又是活的。

paragraphs.en: A partial equivalence, rather than a total one, is used so that some transitions may carry no liveness requirement at all: only transitions in the domain of ∼ \sim form classes and thereby incur a liveness obligation, while transitions outside the domain—belonging to no class—may occur in a correct run but are never required to. A run with uncountably many classes enabled in every state of a suffix is not live.
paragraphs.zh: 使用部分等价关系而非完全等价关系，是为了让某些迁移可以完全不携带活性要求：只有处于 ∼ \sim 定义域内的迁移才构成等价类并因此承担活性义务，而定义域之外的迁移——不属于任何类——可以出现在正确的运行中，但从不被强制要求发生。 在某个后缀的每个状态中都有不可数多个类被启用的运行不是活的。

paragraphs.en: A volition-guarded transaction with an empty guard ( Q ′ = ∅ Q^{\prime}=\emptyset ) requires no volitions and is enabled whenever its machine precondition is met. paragraphs.en: Protocols and grassroots protocols. A protocol is a family of multiagent transition systems, one for each set of agents P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi , which share an underlying set of local machine states 𝒮 \mathcal{S} with a designated initial state s 0 s_{0} . A local-states function maps every set of agents P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi to an arbitrary set of local machine states S ⁡ ( P ) ⊂ 𝒮 S(P)\subset\mathcal{S} that includes s 0 s_{0} and satisfies P ⊂ P ′ ⊂ Π ⟹ S ⁡ ( P ) ⊂ S ⁡ ( P ′ ) P\subset P^{\prime}\subset\Pi\implies S(P)\subset S(P^{\prime}) .

paragraphs.en: Being oblivious means two disjoint groups coexist without interference: any interleaving of a correct run of one with a correct run of the other is a correct run of the combined system. Being interactive means two groups that have not yet interacted can still do so: the combined system has a correct continuation in which a single transaction engages agents of both groups. Agents that have taken part in a common interaction are joined; an instance is a maximal set of agents joined directly or indirectly, and two instances coalesce when they come to be one.
paragraphs.zh: 「无感知」意味着两个不相交的群组可以互不干扰地共存：将其中一方的正确运行与另一方的正确运行任意交错，所得到的仍是组合系统的正确运行。 「可交互」意味着尚未交互过的两个群组之后仍可以发生交互：组合系统存在一个正确的后续过程，其中单个事务同时涉足两个群组的智能体。 参与过同一交互的智能体即被联结；一个实例是直接或间接联结的智能体的极大集合，当两个实例合为一体时即发生合并。

paragraphs.en: The obliviousness results rest on the following invariant: in a group’s own system an agent wills only transactions internal to the group, so the guard of a transaction that reaches another group cannot will it while the group runs alone, and the transaction is never enabled in an interleaving.
paragraphs.zh: 无知性结果依赖于以下不变式：在一个群组自己的系统中，智能体只会意志群组内部的事务，因此到达另一个群组的事务的守卫在该群组单独运行时不可能意志它，并且该事务在任何交错中都不会被启用。

paragraphs.en: A volitional transactions-based protocol is oblivious provided that for every disjoint nonempty P , P ′ ⊂ Π P,P^{\prime}\subset\Pi , no equivalence class whose transactions have participants spanning both P P and P ′ P^{\prime} is ever enabled in any interleaving of correct runs of ℱ ⁡ ( P ) \mathcal{F}(P) and ℱ ⁡ ( P ′ ) \mathcal{F}(P^{\prime}) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于意愿交易的协议是遗忘的（oblivious），前提是：对于每一对不相交的非空集合 P,P′⊂Π，在 ℱ(P) 和 ℱ(P′) 的正确运行的任意交错执行中，任何其交易的参与者同时跨越 P 和 P′ 的等价类都永远不会被启用。

paragraphs.en: A volitional transactions-based protocol over a set of volition-guarded transactions R R is oblivious if every volition-guarded transaction ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R (t,Q^{\prime})\in R whose machine transaction t t has two or more participants has a nonempty guard, Q ′ ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\neq\emptyset .
paragraphs.zh: 基于一组意愿守卫交易 R R 的意愿性交易协议，如果其中每一个其机器交易 t t 具有两个或更多参与者的意愿守卫交易 ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R (t,Q^{\prime})\in R 都拥有非空守卫，即 Q ′ ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\neq\emptyset ，则称该协议是无意识的（oblivious）。

paragraphs.en: In a run of ℱ ⁡ ( P ∪ P ′ ) \mathcal{F}(P\cup P^{\prime}) a member may will a transaction reaching the other group, which a group’s own run forbids; the volitional notion constrains the resulting coupling:
paragraphs.zh: 在 ℱ ⁡ ( P ∪ P ′ ) \mathcal{F}(P\cup P^{\prime}) 的一次运行中，某个成员可能意愿达成一项抵达另一群体的事务，而该群体自身的运行是禁止这种事务的；意志性概念对由此产生的耦合施加了约束：

Then x x has left in c c if no ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R ⁡ ( Q ) (t,Q^{\prime})\in R(Q) with x ∈ Q ′ x\in Q^{\prime} is machine-enabled in any configuration c ′ c^{\prime} of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) with c → ∗ c ′ ⊆ T ⁡ ( Q ) c\xrightarrow{*}c^{\prime}\subseteq T(Q) .
paragraphs.zh: 设 ℱ \mathcal{F} 是基于 R R 、Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi 上的意志交易的协议，c c 是 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的一个配置，且 x ∈ Q x\in Q 。 若在 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的任何满足 c → ∗ c ′ ⊆ T ⁡ ( Q ) c\xrightarrow{*}c^{\prime}\subseteq T(Q) 的配置 c ′ c^{\prime} 中，不存在机器启用的 ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R ⁡ ( Q ) (t,Q^{\prime})\in R(Q) 且 x ∈ Q ′ x\in Q^{\prime} ，则称 x x 在 c c 中已离开。

sents.en: Let ℱ \mathcal{F} be a volitional transactions-based protocol over R R , Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , c c a configuration of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) , and x ∈ Q x\in Q .

sents.en: Then x x has left in c c if no ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R ⁡ ( Q ) (t,Q^{\prime})\in R(Q) with x ∈ Q ′ x\in Q^{\prime} is machine-enabled in any configuration c ′ c^{\prime} of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) with c → ∗ c ′ ⊆ T ⁡ ( Q ) c\xrightarrow{*}c^{\prime}\subseteq T(Q) .

paragraphs.en: A volitional transactions-based protocol ℱ \mathcal{F} is interactive among the agents that have not left if for every Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi and disjoint nonempty P , P ′ ⊆ Q P,P^{\prime}\subseteq Q , every prefix of a correct run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) containing no interaction between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} , in whose last configuration some agent of P P and some agent of P ′ P^{\prime} have not left, is a prefix of a correct run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) that contains one.
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于意志性交易的协议 ℱ \mathcal{F} 在尚未离开的智能体之间是交互式的，如果对于每个 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi 以及不相交的非空集合 P , P ′ ⊆ Q P,P^{\prime}\subseteq Q ， ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的每一次正确运行的前缀——该前缀不包含 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间的交互，且在其最后一个配置中 P P 的某个智能体与 P ′ P^{\prime} 的某个智能体尚未离开——都是 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的一个包含此类交互的正确运行的前缀。

paragraphs.en: An interactive protocol is interactive among the agents that have not left, the latter requiring a continuation of fewer prefixes. A group all of whose agents have left can never be connected by an act one of them wills, and the definition asks nothing of it.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式协议是在尚未离开的智能体之间进行交互的协议，后者要求继续的前缀更少。 一个所有智能体都已离开的群体永远无法通过其中某个智能体意愿的行为重新连接，而且该定义对它没有任何要求。

paragraphs.en: A volitional transactions-based protocol ℱ \mathcal{F} is volitionally grassroots if it is oblivious, interactive among the agents that have not left, and, for every disjoint nonempty P , P ′ ⊂ Π P,P^{\prime}\subset\Pi and every safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( P ∪ P ′ ) \mathcal{F}(P\cup P^{\prime}) interactive between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} , the first interaction of P P and P ′ P^{\prime} is induced by a volition-guarded transaction ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) with Q ′ ∩ P ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\cap P\neq\emptyset and Q ′ ∩ P ′ ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\cap P^{\prime}\neq\emptyset .
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于意志交易的协议 ℱ \mathcal{F} 是意志草根的，如果它是遗忘的、在尚未离开的智能体之间交互，并且，对于每一对不相交的非空集合 P , P ′ ⊂ Π P,P^{\prime}\subset\Pi 以及 ℱ ⁡ ( P ∪ P ′ ) \mathcal{F}(P\cup P^{\prime}) 的每一次在 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间交互的安全运行， P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 的首次交互都由一个意志守护的交易 ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) 诱导，其中 Q ′ ∩ P ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\cap P\neq\emptyset 且 Q ′ ∩ P ′ ≠ ∅ Q^{\prime}\cap P^{\prime}\neq\emptyset 。

paragraphs.en: Two groups thus become connected only by an act a person of each wills, and a grassroots protocol meeting the condition on first interactions is volitionally grassroots. An else transaction (Definition A.5 ) is over a single participant and so is never an interaction; a binary transaction with an else-branch would let an agent of another group, who never wills it, trigger it, and could be a first interaction willed by neither, which is why Definition A.4 admits only unary ones.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，两个群体仅通过各自一名成员意愿实施的行为而连接起来，而满足首次交互条件的草根协议在意志上是草根的。 一个 else 交易（定义 A.5）只涉及单个参与者，因此绝不是一次交互；带有 else 分支的二元交易会让另一个群体的智能体触发它，而该智能体从未意愿这样做，并且它可能成为双方都未意愿的首次交互，这正是定义 A.4 只接受一元交易的原因。

sents.en: The requirement q ∉ ρ p ∪ μ p ∪ κ p ∪ λ p q\notin\rho_{p}\cup\mu_{p}\cup\kappa_{p}\cup\lambda_{p} of Unfriend stands for the atoms 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( q ) \mathit{principal}(q) , 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guarded\_by}(q) , 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( q ) \mathit{principal\_of}(q) and 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑛 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guardian\_of}(q) forbidden at p p , and q ∉ ρ r ∪ μ r q\notin\rho_{r}\cup\mu_{r} of Agent unfriend for 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( q ) \mathit{principal}(q) and 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guarded\_by}(q) forbidden at r r .
sents.zh: Unfriend 中的要求 q ∉ ρ p ∪ μ p ∪ κ p ∪ λ p q\notin\rho_{p}\cup\mu_{p}\cup\kappa_{p}\cup\lambda_{p} 表示在 p p 处禁止的原子 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( q ) \mathit{principal}(q)、𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guarded\_by}(q)、𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( q ) \mathit{principal\_of}(q) 和 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑛 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guardian\_of}(q)，而 Agent unfriend 中的 q ∉ ρ r ∪ μ r q\notin\rho_{r}\cup\mu_{r} 表示在 r r 处禁止的 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( q ) \mathit{principal}(q) 和 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( q ) \mathit{guarded\_by}(q)。

sents.en: The requirement r ∈ κ p r\in\kappa_{p} stands for 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r ) \mathit{principal\_of}(r) at p p , r ∈ λ p r\in\lambda_{p} for 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑛 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r ) \mathit{guardian\_of}(r) at p p , and ρ r = { p } \rho_{r}=\{p\} of Retire for 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( p ) \mathit{principal}(p) at r r ; Enter sets ρ r \rho_{r} and κ p \kappa_{p} together and no transaction changes either.
sents.zh: 要求 r ∈ κ p r\in\kappa_{p} 表示在 p p 处的 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r ) \mathit{principal\_of}(r)，r ∈ λ p r\in\lambda_{p} 表示在 p p 处的 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑛 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r ) \mathit{guardian\_of}(r)，Retire 中的 ρ r = { p } \rho_{r}=\{p\} 表示在 r r 处的 𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑝𝑎𝑙 ⁡ ( p ) \mathit{principal}(p)；Enter 同时设置 ρ r \rho_{r} 和 κ p \kappa_{p}，且没有任何事务会更改二者。

sents.en: The requirement y ∈ α p y\in\alpha_{p} of Enter stands for 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( y ) \mathit{authored}(y) at p p , y y the attestation p p signed, its content naming the AI agent’s public key and the code its developer signed (GAI: 2 ); y ∈ γ r y\in\gamma_{r} for 𝑎𝑡𝑡𝑒𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ⁡ ( y ) \mathit{attestation}(y) at r r ; and ( r , y ) ∈ ϵ p (r,y)\in\epsilon_{p} for its record 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r , y ) \mathit{agent\_of}(r,y) at p p , which Enter adds at the principal and Make guardian at another guardian, and from which the guardian’s machine fills the request; x ∈ α p x\in\alpha_{p} of Message stands for 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( x ) \mathit{authored}(x) at p p , and x ∉ α p x\notin\alpha_{p} of Forward for 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( x ) \mathit{authored}(x) forbidden there.
sents.zh: Enter 中的要求 y ∈ α p y\in\alpha_{p} 表示在 p p 处的 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( y ) \mathit{authored}(y)，其中 y y 是 p p 签署的证明，其内容指明了该智能体的公钥及其开发者签署的代码（GAI: 2）；y ∈ γ r y\in\gamma_{r} 表示在 r r 处的 𝑎𝑡𝑡𝑒𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ⁡ ( y ) \mathit{attestation}(y)；而 ( r , y ) ∈ ϵ p (r,y)\in\epsilon_{p} 表示在 p p 处的其记录 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 ​ _ ​ 𝑜𝑓 ​ ( r , y ) \mathit{agent\_of}(r,y)，Enter 在主体处添加该记录，Make guardian 在另一个守护者处添加该记录，守护者的机器依据该记录填写请求；Message 中的 x ∈ α p x\in\alpha_{p} 表示在 p p 处的 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( x ) \mathit{authored}(x)，Forward 中的 x ∉ α p x\notin\alpha_{p} 表示在该处禁止的 𝑎𝑢𝑡ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑒𝑑 ⁡ ( x ) \mathit{authored}(x)。

sents.en: Retire takes every friend and every guardian of r r by the listed roles r ⁡ [ 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 ⁡ ( ∗ ) ] r[\mathit{friend}(\ast)] and r ⁡ [ 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( ∗ ) ] r[\mathit{guarded\_by}(\ast)] , based on its first role, r r , and clears 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} and 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 \mathit{guarded\_by} at r r ( Golike et al., 2026 ; Keidar and Shapiro, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Retire 依据其第一个角色 r r，通过所列角色 r ⁡ [ 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 ⁡ ( ∗ ) ] r[\mathit{friend}(\ast)] 和 r ⁡ [ 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 ​ ( ∗ ) ] r[\mathit{guarded\_by}(\ast)] 获取 r r 的每一个好友和每一个守护者，并在 r r 处清除 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} 和 𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑟𝑑𝑒𝑑 ​ _ ​ 𝑏𝑦 \mathit{guarded\_by}（Golike et al., 2026；Keidar and Shapiro, 2026）。

sents.en: The requirement θ = 0 \theta=0 at each guard stands for 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑑 \mathit{retired} forbidden at every guarding role.
sents.zh: 在每个守护角色处的要求 θ = 0 \theta=0 表示在每个守护角色处禁止的 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑑 \mathit{retired}。

paragraphs.en: The component ν p \nu_{p} is a multiset: Acquaint, Agent acquaint and Agents acquaint neither require nor forbid that the two know each other, and add a copy of each at the other whether they do or not, so that two agents who know each other may take the act again. 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} and 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} are reflexive, so that in Agents acquaint and Agents befriend one person may be the guardian of both AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 分量 ν p \nu_{p} 是一个多重集：Acquaint、Agent acquaint 和 Agents acquaint 既不要求也不禁止两个智能体彼此认识，并且无论它们是否认识，都会在对方处添加一份副本，因此已经互相认识的两个智能体可以再次执行该动作。𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} 和 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} 是自反的，因此在 Agents acquaint 和 Agents befriend 中，同一个人可以同时是两个 AI 智能体的监护人。

paragraphs.en: Transaction equivalence. The equivalence ∼ \sim is that of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) : one schema at one admissible binding determines one class, whose members differ only in the configuration in which they occur. All Acquaint ( p , q ) (p,q) transactions form one class, and so do all Introduce ( p , q , c ) (p,q;c) , all Befriend ( p , q ) (p,q) , all Unfriend ( p , q ) (p,q) , all End guardian ( p , q , r ) (p,q,r) , all Resign ( q , r ) (q,r) , all Guardian unfriend ( q , r ) (q,r) , all Agent befriend ( r , q , p ) (r,q,p) , all Agents befriend ( r , s , p , q ) (r,s,p,q) , all Agent unfriend ( r , q , p ) (r,q,p) and all Retire ( p , r ) (p,r) with the same agents; all Enter ( p , r , y ) (p,r;y) , all Make guardian ( p , q , r , y ) (p,q,r;y) , all Agent acquaint ( r , q , p , y ) (r,q,p;y) and all Agents acquaint ( r , s , p , q , y , z ) (r,s,p,q;y,z) with the same agents and speech acts; each Establish ( p ) (p) ; each Sign ( p ; x ) (p;x) with the same item; and each Message ( p , q , x ) (p,q;x) and each Forward ( p , q , x ) (p,q;x) with the same agents and item.
paragraphs.zh: 事务等价性。 等价关系 ∼ \sim 与 (Golike et al., 2026) 中定义的相同：在某个可采纳绑定下的一个模式确定一个类，类的成员仅在它们出现的配置上有所不同。 所有 Acquaint ( p , q ) (p,q) 事务构成一个类，所有具有相同智能体的 Introduce ( p , q , c ) (p,q;c) 、Befriend ( p , q ) (p,q) 、Unfriend ( p , q ) (p,q) 、End guardian ( p , q , r ) (p,q,r) 、Resign ( q , r ) (q,r) 、Guardian unfriend ( q , r ) (q,r) 、Agent befriend ( r , q , p ) (r,q,p) 、Agents befriend ( r , s , p , q ) (r,s,p,q) 、Agent unfriend ( r , q , p ) (r,q,p) 和 Retire ( p , r ) (p,r) 事务各自构成一个类；所有具有相同智能体和言语行为的 Enter ( p , r , y ) (p,r;y) 、Make guardian ( p , q , r , y ) (p,q,r;y) 、Agent acquaint ( r , q , p , y ) (r,q,p;y) 和 Agents acquaint ( r , s , p , q , y , z ) (r,s,p,q;y,z) 事务各自构成一个类；每个 Establish ( p ) (p) 构成一个类；具有相同条目的每个 Sign ( p ; x ) (p;x) 构成一个类；以及具有相同智能体和条目的每个 Message ( p , q , x ) (p,q;x) 和每个 Forward ( p , q , x ) (p,q;x) 各构成一个类。

paragraphs.en: This appendix defines contracts with wards, agents who act only with the consent of a guardian, as an extension of the speech-act schema language of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) : a child with their parents ( Shapiro, 2026a ) , an AI agent with its principal. The GnW contract (Section 3.1 ) marks a ward as one and lets only the unsupervised come to know each other (GKK: 2 ), so a contract extending it has no act that any two agents can take and is not syntactically grassroots in the sense of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) ; the protocol realising it is volitionally grassroots nonetheless, since a ward enters the contract with a guardian recorded, who is not a ward, and comes to know, through their guardian, anyone their guardian can come to know, and a retired ward has left. Section C.1 recalls the language and the results of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) this appendix uses, with the two additions the extension makes to the language, reflexive predicates and signed terms; Section C.2 states conditions on the schemas under which a contract with wards is certified, decidable as the conditions of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) are, and proves them sufficient (Theorem C.20 ); Section C.3 certifies the social network with provenance of Section 4 (Proposition C.21 ) and the contract of this paper (Proposition C.22 ). The checker of ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , in the repository https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP , decides the conditions of this appendix as well.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录定义带有受监护人（wards）的契约——受监护人是指仅在监护人同意下行事的智能体（agents）——作为（Golike et al., 2026）的言语行为模式语言的一个扩展：例如孩子与其父母（Shapiro, 2026a），或AI智能体与其委托人。 GnW契约（第3.1节）将一个受监护人标记为受监护人，并只让不受监护者相互认识（GKK: 2），因此扩展它的契约没有任何两个智能体都能采取的行为，并且在（Golike et al., 2026）的意义上不是语法上自下而上的；然而实现它的协议在意志上是自下而上的，因为受监护人进入契约时记录了一名监护人，该监护人不是受监护人，并且受监护人通过其监护人认识其监护人能认识的任何人，而退出的受监护人已经离开。 第C.1节回顾本附录所使用的（Golike et al., 2026）的语言和结果，以及该扩展对语言所做的两项补充——自反谓词与签名项；第C.2节陈述带受监护人的契约通过认证所依据的模式条件，这些条件如（Golike et al., 2026）的条件一样是可判定的，并证明它们是充分的（定理C.20）；第C.3节认证第4节带来源的社会网络（命题C.21）以及本文的契约（命题C.22）。 （Golike et al., 2026）的检查器，位于代码仓库 https://github.com/EShapiro2/GLP ，也能判定本附录的条件。

paragraphs.en: Atoms and states. Π \Pi is a countable, potentially infinite set of agents and Δ \Delta a countable set of utterances disjoint from it. A speech act is an utterance or a speech act signed by an agent: D D is the least set with Δ × Π ⊆ D \Delta\times\Pi\subseteq D and D × Π ⊆ D D\times\Pi\subseteq D , the signer of ( x , p ) ∈ D (x,p)\in D is p p , and D P := { d ∈ D : signer ⁡ ( d ) ∈ P } D_{P}:=\{d\in D:\mathrm{signer}(d)\in P\} for P ⊆ Π P\subseteq\Pi ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) . Σ \Sigma is a set of predicates , each with an arity; an atom is a predicate applied to as many arguments as its arity, a syntactic object with no truth value, and it names what is among its arguments or is the signer of one. A local state is a finite multiset of atoms over Π ∪ D \Pi\cup D , the initial state s 0 s_{0} is empty, and S C ​ ( P ) S_{C}(P) is the set of finite multisets of atoms over P ∪ D P P\cup D_{P} ( Golike et al., 2026 ) . Multiset sum, difference, intersection and inclusion are ⊎ \uplus , ∖ \setminus , ∩ \cap and ⊆ \subseteq , and the join ⨆ j s j \bigsqcup_{j}s_{j} takes the greatest multiplicity. A mark is a predicate of arity zero, and its atom is written as the mark. A schema is written over disjoint sets R R of roles , X X of agent variables and Y Y of speech-act variables , disjoint from Π \Pi and D D .
paragraphs.zh: 原子与状态。Π \Pi 是一个可数的、可能无限的智能体集合，Δ \Delta 是一个与其不相交的可数话语集合。 言语行为是一个话语，或由智能体签署的言语行为：D D 是满足 Δ × Π ⊆ D \Delta\times\Pi\subseteq D 且 D × Π ⊆ D D\times\Pi\subseteq D 的最小集合，( x , p ) ∈ D (x,p)\in D 的签署者是 p p，且对于 P ⊆ Π P\subseteq\Pi 有 D P := { d ∈ D : signer ⁡ ( d ) ∈ P } D_{P}:=\{d\in D:\mathrm{signer}(d)\in P\}（Cardelli et al., 2020；Golike and Shapiro, 2026）。Σ \Sigma 是一个谓词集合，每个谓词都有其元数；原子是将谓词应用于与其元数相同数量的参数，是一个没有真值的句法对象，它命名其参数之间的事物，或是其中之一的签署者。 局部状态是 Π ∪ D \Pi\cup D 上原子的有限多重集，初始状态 s 0 s_{0} 为空，S C ​ ( P ) S_{C}(P) 是 P ∪ D P P\cup D_{P} 上原子的有限多重集的集合（Golike et al., 2026）。 多重集的和、差、交与包含分别记为 ⊎ \uplus、∖ \setminus、∩ \cap 与 ⊆ \subseteq，而联接 ⨆ j s j \bigsqcup_{j}s_{j} 取最大的重数。 标记是一个元数为零的谓词，其原子就写作该标记。 模式写在互不相交的角色集合 R R、智能体变量集合 X X 与言语行为变量集合 Y Y 上，它们与 Π \Pi 和 D D 均不相交。

sents.en: Atoms and states. Π \Pi is a countable, potentially infinite set of agents and Δ \Delta a countable set of utterances disjoint from it.
sents.zh: 原子与状态。Π \Pi 是一个可数的、可能无限的智能体集合，Δ \Delta 是一个与其不相交的可数话语集合。

sents.en: A speech act is an utterance or a speech act signed by an agent: D D is the least set with Δ × Π ⊆ D \Delta\times\Pi\subseteq D and D × Π ⊆ D D\times\Pi\subseteq D , the signer of ( x , p ) ∈ D (x,p)\in D is p p , and D P := { d ∈ D : signer ⁡ ( d ) ∈ P } D_{P}:=\{d\in D:\mathrm{signer}(d)\in P\} for P ⊆ Π P\subseteq\Pi ( Cardelli et al., 2020 ; Golike and Shapiro, 2026 ) . Σ \Sigma is a set of predicates , each with an arity; an atom is a predicate applied to as many arguments as its arity, a syntactic object with no truth value, and it names what is among its arguments or is the signer of one.
sents.zh: 言语行为是一个话语，或由智能体签署的言语行为：D D 是满足 Δ × Π ⊆ D \Delta\times\Pi\subseteq D 且 D × Π ⊆ D D\times\Pi\subseteq D 的最小集合，( x , p ) ∈ D (x,p)\in D 的签署者是 p p，且对于 P ⊆ Π P\subseteq\Pi 有 D P := { d ∈ D : signer ⁡ ( d ) ∈ P } D_{P}:=\{d\in D:\mathrm{signer}(d)\in P\}（Cardelli et al., 2020；Golike and Shapiro, 2026）。Σ \Sigma 是一个谓词集合，每个谓词都有其元数；原子是将谓词应用于与其元数相同数量的参数，是一个没有真值的句法对象，它命名其参数之间的事物，或是其中之一的签署者。

sents.en: A local state is a finite multiset of atoms over Π ∪ D \Pi\cup D , the initial state s 0 s_{0} is empty, and S C ​ ( P ) S_{C}(P) is the set of finite multisets of atoms over P ∪ D P P\cup D_{P} ( Golike et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 局部状态是 Π ∪ D \Pi\cup D 上原子的有限多重集，初始状态 s 0 s_{0} 为空，S C ​ ( P ) S_{C}(P) 是 P ∪ D P P\cup D_{P} 上原子的有限多重集的集合（Golike et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Multiset sum, difference, intersection and inclusion are ⊎ \uplus , ∖ \setminus , ∩ \cap and ⊆ \subseteq , and the join ⨆ j s j \bigsqcup_{j}s_{j} takes the greatest multiplicity.
sents.zh: 多重集的和、差、交与包含分别记为 ⊎ \uplus、∖ \setminus、∩ \cap 与 ⊆ \subseteq，而联接 ⨆ j s j \bigsqcup_{j}s_{j} 取最大的重数。

sents.en: A mark is a predicate of arity zero, and its atom is written as the mark.
sents.zh: 标记是一个元数为零的谓词，其原子就写作该标记。

sents.en: A schema is written over disjoint sets R R of roles , X X of agent variables and Y Y of speech-act variables , disjoint from Π \Pi and D D .
sents.zh: 模式写在互不相交的角色集合 R R、智能体变量集合 X X 与言语行为变量集合 Y Y 上，它们与 Π \Pi 和 D D 均不相交。

sents.en: A speech-act schema is written τ ( π 1 , … , π k ; x 1 , … , x m ) : E 1 ⋯ E k \tau(\pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k};\,x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}):E_{1}\cdots E_{k} , with τ \tau its name, π 1 , … , π k ∈ R \pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k}\in R distinct, each possibly carrying the mark ? ? and those that do its guarding roles , k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 its arity , x 1 , … , x m ∈ X ∪ Y x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\in X\cup Y distinct, its variables , T τ T_{\tau} the set of its signed terms sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) \mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi) with y y one of its variables in Y Y and π \pi one of its roles, and each E i E_{i} a finite multiset of atoms over { π 1 , … , π k , x 1 , … , x m } ∪ T τ \{\pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k},x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\}\cup T_{\tau} , each carrying at most one of the marks − - , + + , ¬ \neg .
sents.zh: 言语行为模式写作 τ ( π 1 , … , π k ; x 1 , … , x m ) : E 1 ⋯ E k \tau(\pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k};\,x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}):E_{1}\cdots E_{k} ，其中 τ \tau 是其名称， π 1 , … , π k ∈ R \pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k}\in R 互不相同，每个角色可以带有标记 ? ? ，带有该标记的角色称为其守护角色 ， k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 是其元数 ， x 1 , … , x m ∈ X ∪ Y x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\in X\cup Y 互不相同，称为其变量 ， T τ T_{\tau} 是其带符号项 sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) \mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi) 的集合，其中 y y 是其在 Y Y 中的某个变量， π \pi 是其某个角色，且每个 E i E_{i} 是 { π 1 , … , π k , x 1 , … , x m } ∪ T τ \{\pi_{1},\ldots,\pi_{k},x_{1},\ldots,x_{m}\}\cup T_{\tau} 上的原子的有限多重集，每个原子至多带有标记 − - 、 + + 、 ¬ \neg 中的一种。

sents.en: It is required that + ​ ( i ) ∩ - ​ ( i ) = ∅ \mathord{+}(i)\cap\mathord{-}(i)=\emptyset , that + ​ ( i ) ⊎ - ​ ( i ) ≠ ∅ \mathord{+}(i)\uplus\mathord{-}(i)\neq\emptyset at every role that is not a guarding role and at some role, that a signed term occurs only in an atom marked + + , and that its speech-act variable occurs in an atom its role requires.
sents.zh: 要求满足： + ​ ( i ) ∩ - ​ ( i ) = ∅ \mathord{+}(i)\cap\mathord{-}(i)=\emptyset ；在每一个非守护角色处以及至少在某个角色处 + ​ ( i ) ⊎ - ​ ( i ) ≠ ∅ \mathord{+}(i)\uplus\mathord{-}(i)\neq\emptyset ；带符号项只出现在被标记为 + + 的原子中；且其言语行为变量出现在其角色所需要的某个原子中。

sents.en: A contract C C is a finite set of speech-act schemas over Σ \Sigma .
sents.zh: 合同 C C 是 Σ \Sigma 上言语行为模式的有限集合。

paragraphs.en: A schema may also have, for an agent role π \pi of it and a predicate ρ \rho , the listed role π ⁡ [ ρ ⁡ ( ∗ , u 2 , … , u r ) ] \pi[\rho(\ast,u_{2},\ldots,u_{r})] , whose participants at a binding are every agent q q with ρ ⁡ ( q , β ⁡ ( u 2 ) , … , β ⁡ ( u r ) ) \rho(q,\beta(u_{2}),\ldots,\beta(u_{r})) in the state of β ⁡ ( π ) \beta(\pi) , and an atom marked − - at a role may carry the wildcard ∗ \ast among its arguments, a cleared atom, which deletes every atom of the state it matches and requires none ( Golike et al., 2026 ) ; Retire takes every friend and every guardian of the AI agent by two listed roles and clears its friendships and guardianships, and Unfriend clears every membership between the two (Appendix B ). The results recalled below hold with them ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , and the proofs of this appendix use of them only that the extent of a listed role lies in one instance with its base and that a cleared atom requires nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 一个模式（schema）还可以为其某个智能体角色 π \pi 和谓词 ρ \rho 定义列出角色 π ⁡ [ ρ ⁡ ( ∗ , u 2 , … , u r ) ] \pi[\rho(\ast,u_{2},\ldots,u_{r})] ，在绑定时其参与者为状态 β ⁡ ( π ) \beta(\pi) 中满足 ρ ⁡ ( q , β ⁡ ( u 2 ) , … , β ⁡ ( u r ) ) \rho(q,\beta(u_{2}),\ldots,\beta(u_{r})) 的每个智能体 q q ；并且在某个角色处标记为 − - 的原子可以在其参数中携带通配符 ∗ \ast ，即清除原子（cleared atom），它会删除状态中与之匹配的每个原子而不需要任何原子（Golike et al., 2026）；Retire 通过两个列出角色取得该智能体的每个朋友和每个监护人，并清除其友谊和监护关系，而 Unfriend 清除这两个智能体之间的每个成员关系（附录 B）。 下文回顾的结果在这些定义下成立（Golike et al., 2026），且本附录的证明只用到它们中的以下两点：列出角色的范围位于与其基础角色相同的单个实例中，以及清除原子不要求任何东西。

sents.en: A schema may also have, for an agent role π \pi of it and a predicate ρ \rho , the listed role π ⁡ [ ρ ⁡ ( ∗ , u 2 , … , u r ) ] \pi[\rho(\ast,u_{2},\ldots,u_{r})] , whose participants at a binding are every agent q q with ρ ⁡ ( q , β ⁡ ( u 2 ) , … , β ⁡ ( u r ) ) \rho(q,\beta(u_{2}),\ldots,\beta(u_{r})) in the state of β ⁡ ( π ) \beta(\pi) , and an atom marked − - at a role may carry the wildcard ∗ \ast among its arguments, a cleared atom, which deletes every atom of the state it matches and requires none ( Golike et al., 2026 ) ; Retire takes every friend and every guardian of the AI agent by two listed roles and clears its friendships and guardianships, and Unfriend clears every membership between the two (Appendix B ).
sents.zh: 一个模式（schema）还可以为其某个智能体角色 π \pi 和谓词 ρ \rho 定义列出角色 π ⁡ [ ρ ⁡ ( ∗ , u 2 , … , u r ) ] \pi[\rho(\ast,u_{2},\ldots,u_{r})] ，在绑定时其参与者为状态 β ⁡ ( π ) \beta(\pi) 中满足 ρ ⁡ ( q , β ⁡ ( u 2 ) , … , β ⁡ ( u r ) ) \rho(q,\beta(u_{2}),\ldots,\beta(u_{r})) 的每个智能体 q q ；并且在某个角色处标记为 − - 的原子可以在其参数中携带通配符 ∗ \ast ，即清除原子（cleared atom），它会删除状态中与之匹配的每个原子而不需要任何原子（Golike et al., 2026）；Retire 通过两个列出角色取得该智能体的每个朋友和每个监护人，并清除其友谊和监护关系，而 Unfriend 清除这两个智能体之间的每个成员关系（附录 B）。

sents.en: The results recalled below hold with them ( Golike et al., 2026 ) , and the proofs of this appendix use of them only that the extent of a listed role lies in one instance with its base and that a cleared atom requires nothing.
sents.zh: 下文回顾的结果在这些定义下成立（Golike et al., 2026），且本附录的证明只用到它们中的以下两点：列出角色的范围位于与其基础角色相同的单个实例中，以及清除原子不要求任何东西。

paragraphs.en: A binding β \beta for a schema τ \tau maps its roles and agent variables to Π \Pi and Y Y to D D , with β ⁡ ( sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) ) := ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) \beta(\mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi)):=(\beta(y),\beta(\pi)) , distinct roles to distinct agents, but for two the schema marks as possibly one, which it may send to one agent if neither of them adds or deletes an atom naming the other, and is extended to atoms and to multisets of them componentwise. It is admissible if every speech-act variable of τ \tau that occurs in an atom added at a role and in no atom required at a role is mapped to a speech act signed by the agent in a guarding role of τ \tau .
paragraphs.zh: 模式 τ \tau 的绑定 β \beta 将其角色和智能体变量映射到 Π \Pi，将 Y Y 映射到 D D，并满足 β ⁡ ( sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) ) := ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) \beta(\mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi)):=(\beta(y),\beta(\pi))，不同的角色映射到不同的智能体，但对于该模式标记为可能相同的两个角色，若二者均未添加或删除命名对方的原子，则该模式可将其中一者发送给一个智能体，并且该绑定按分量的方式扩展到原子及原子的多重集。 若 τ \tau 中每个出现在某角色添加的原子中且不出现在任何角色所需的原子中的言语行为变量，都被映射为由 τ \tau 的守护角色中的智能体所签署的言语行为，则该绑定是可采纳的。

sents.en: A binding β \beta for a schema τ \tau maps its roles and agent variables to Π \Pi and Y Y to D D , with β ⁡ ( sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) ) := ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) \beta(\mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi)):=(\beta(y),\beta(\pi)) , distinct roles to distinct agents, but for two the schema marks as possibly one, which it may send to one agent if neither of them adds or deletes an atom naming the other, and is extended to atoms and to multisets of them componentwise.
sents.zh: 模式 τ \tau 的绑定 β \beta 将其角色和智能体变量映射到 Π \Pi，将 Y Y 映射到 D D，并满足 β ⁡ ( sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) ) := ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) \beta(\mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi)):=(\beta(y),\beta(\pi))，不同的角色映射到不同的智能体，但对于该模式标记为可能相同的两个角色，若二者均未添加或删除命名对方的原子，则该模式可将其中一者发送给一个智能体，并且该绑定按分量的方式扩展到原子及原子的多重集。

sents.en: It is admissible if every speech-act variable of τ \tau that occurs in an atom added at a role and in no atom required at a role is mapped to a speech act signed by the agent in a guarding role of τ \tau .
sents.zh: 若 τ \tau 中每个出现在某角色添加的原子中且不出现在任何角色所需的原子中的言语行为变量，都被映射为由 τ \tau 的守护角色中的智能体所签署的言语行为，则该绑定是可采纳的。

paragraphs.en: Reflexive predicates. Two roles sent to one agent are carried out by that agent together. A role that adds or deletes an atom naming another cannot share its agent, so no relation a contract records is reflexive. The extension lets a contract declare a predicate of arity one reflexive : every state is then taken to hold the atom of that predicate naming its holder, and no schema adds or deletes, at a role, the atom of it naming that role. For a configuration d d and an agent p p , d ^ p \hat{d}_{p} is d p d_{p} together with the atom naming p p of every reflexive predicate; in a contract declaring none, d ^ p = d p \hat{d}_{p}=d_{p} . The child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) and the contract of this paper declare 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} and 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} reflexive, so that two wards with one guardian may come to know each other and befriend by an act in which that guardian takes both guardian roles (GnW: 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 自反谓词。 发送给同一个智能体的两个角色由该智能体一并执行。 一个添加或删除命名另一角色的原子的角色不能与其共享智能体，因此契约所记录的任何关系都不是自反的。 该扩展允许契约声明一个元数为 1 的谓词是自反的：于是每个状态都被视为持有命名其持有者的该谓词的原子，并且任何模式都不会在某一角色处添加或删除命名该角色的该谓词的原子。 对于配置 d d 和智能体 p p，d ^ p \hat{d}_{p} 是 d p d_{p} 连同每个自反谓词命名 p p 的原子；在不声明任何自反谓词的契约中，d ^ p = d p \hat{d}_{p}=d_{p}。 儿童安全的社交网络（Shapiro, 2026a）与本文的契约将 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} 和 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} 声明为自反的，使得共用一名监护人的两个被监护人可以通过该监护人同时承担两个监护人角色的行为而相互认识并成为朋友（GnW: 4）。

sents.en: Reflexive predicates.
sents.zh: 自反谓词。

sents.en: Two roles sent to one agent are carried out by that agent together.
sents.zh: 发送给同一个智能体的两个角色由该智能体一并执行。

sents.en: For a configuration d d and an agent p p , d ^ p \hat{d}_{p} is d p d_{p} together with the atom naming p p of every reflexive predicate; in a contract declaring none, d ^ p = d p \hat{d}_{p}=d_{p} .

sents.en: The child-safe social network ( Shapiro, 2026a ) and the contract of this paper declare 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} and 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} reflexive, so that two wards with one guardian may come to know each other and befriend by an act in which that guardian takes both guardian roles (GnW: 4 ).
sents.zh: 儿童安全的社交网络（Shapiro, 2026a）与本文的契约将 𝑓𝑟𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑑 \mathit{friend} 和 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} 声明为自反的，使得共用一名监护人的两个被监护人可以通过该监护人同时承担两个监护人角色的行为而相互认识并成为朋友（GnW: 4）。

paragraphs.en: Signed terms. The extension lets a schema add at a role an atom with a signed term sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) \mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi) among its arguments, the speech act y y signed by the agent in the role π \pi : a signed term occurs only in an atom marked + + , its speech-act variable occurs in an atom its role requires, a binding β \beta sends it to ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) (\beta(y),\beta(\pi)) , and in traceable provenance it counts as the two arguments y y and π \pi (Definitions C.1 , C.2 and C.6 ). Forward adds at the recipient 𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑚 ⁡ ( sgn ⁡ ( x , 𝐴𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑒 ) ) \mathit{item}(\mathrm{sgn}(x,\mathit{Alice})) , what Alice held, signed by Alice (Appendix B ). In ( Golike et al., 2026 ) a speech-act variable is bound to a speech act signed by an agent in a guarding role, and no schema signs over what a role holds.
paragraphs.zh: 带符号项。 该扩展允许模式在角色处添加一个以带符号项 sgn ⁡ (y, π) 为参数之一的原子，即智能体以角色 π 签署的言语行为 y：带符号项只出现在标记为 + + 的原子中，其言语行为变量出现在其角色所要求的原子中，绑定 β \beta 将其映射到 (β ⁡ (y), β ⁡ (π))，并且在可追溯出处中它被计为两个参数 y y 和 π \pi（定义 C.1、C.2 和 C.6）。 Forward 在接收方添加 𝑖𝑡𝑒𝑚 ⁡ (sgn ⁡ (x, 𝐴𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑒))，即 Alice 所持有的、由 Alice 签署的内容（附录 B）。 在 (Golike et al., 2026) 中，言语行为变量被绑定到由智能体以守护角色签署的言语行为，并且没有模式对角色所持有的内容进行签署。

sents.en: Signed terms.
sents.zh: 带符号项。

sents.en: The extension lets a schema add at a role an atom with a signed term sgn ⁡ ( y , π ) \mathrm{sgn}(y,\pi) among its arguments, the speech act y y signed by the agent in the role π \pi : a signed term occurs only in an atom marked + + , its speech-act variable occurs in an atom its role requires, a binding β \beta sends it to ( β ⁡ ( y ) , β ⁡ ( π ) ) (\beta(y),\beta(\pi)) , and in traceable provenance it counts as the two arguments y y and π \pi (Definitions C.1 , C.2 and C.6 ).

paragraphs.en: The protocol. From ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) , recalled in Appendix A : for a set R R of volition-guarded transactions over S S and P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi , R ⁡ ( P ) R(P) holds those of them over S ⁡ ( P ′ ) S(P^{\prime}) for some P ′ ⊆ P P^{\prime}\subseteq P , and R R is contained if every transaction of it with participants in P P and source over S ⁡ ( P ) S(P) is in R ⁡ ( P ) R(P) ; the protocol ℱ \mathcal{F} over R R , S S and ∼ \sim has at each Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi the transition system ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) whose transitions are volition changes and the volitional machine transactions the members of R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) induce, each machine-enabled in a configuration whose machine states restrict on its participants to its source, and enabled if every guard holds its class besides; a run is safe if its consecutive configurations form transitions, and correct if besides no class stays enabled forever with no member taken. Every finite safe run is a prefix of a correct run (Lemma Extension of ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 该协议。 根据（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026，重述于附录 A）：对于 S S 上的一个意志守护交易集合 R R 以及 P ⊂ Π P\subset\Pi ， R ⁡ ( P ) R(P) 包含其中那些在某个 P ′ ⊆ P P^{\prime}\subseteq P 上位于 S ⁡ ( P ′ ) S(P^{\prime}) 的交易；若 R R 中每笔参与者属于 P P 且源自 S ⁡ ( P ) S(P) 的交易都在 R ⁡ ( P ) R(P) 中，则称 R R 被包含。基于 R R 、 S S 和 ∼ \sim 的协议 ℱ \mathcal{F} 在每个 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi 处具有转移系统 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q)，其转移为意志变化，以及由 R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) 的成员所引发的意志性机器交易，每笔交易在一个机器状态在其参与者上限制为其来源的配置中由机器启用；若其所有守护条件在其余方面均成立，则该交易是启用的。若一次运行中相继的配置构成转移，则称其是安全的；若除此之外没有任何类永远保持启用却无成员被选取，则称其是正确的。 任何有限的安全运行都是某个正确运行的前缀（引理 Extension，见（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026））。

paragraphs.en: A set R R of volition-guarded transactions is open if for any two agents p ≠ q p\neq q in any Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , every finite safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) with no interaction between p p and q q has a finite safe extension, by volition changes and transitions that are not interactions between p p and q q , at whose end some transaction of R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) whose induced transitions are interactions between p p and q q is machine-enabled; closed if for every Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , every transaction of R R enabled at the end of a finite safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) has all its participants in one instance in that run or a guard in every instance in that run holding one of them; and polite if it is open and closed.
paragraphs.zh: 一组受意志守卫的交易 R R 是开放的，如果对于任何 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi 中的任意两个智能体 p ≠ q p\neq q ，ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的每一个没有 p p 与 q q 之间交互的有限安全运行，都存在一个由意志变更以及非 p p 与 q q 之间交互的迁移构成的有限安全扩展，在其结束时，R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) 中某个其诱导迁移为 p p 与 q q 之间交互的交易是机器可启用的；是封闭的，如果对于每个 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi ，在 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的有限安全运行结束时被启用的 R R 中的每一个交易，其所有参与者在此次运行的某个实例中，或者在此次运行的每个实例中都有一个守卫持有其中之一；是礼貌的，如果它既是开放的又是封闭的。

paragraphs.en: By induction on the run. The initial state is empty. A transition is induced by a transaction determined by a schema at a binding, and changes a state only by the atoms the schema adds and deletes there. Clause 3 keeps the counts of m m and of g g -atoms equal at every role, and by clause 1 at every agent, as a schema adds or deletes them at one role. If the transition adds g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) at p p then by clause 3 it adds m m at p p , by clause 2 it adds ι \iota at p p , and by clause 4 its schema has a a at a role requiring ι \iota and forbidding every mark in M M and adds w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) at a a : so after it p p holds ι \iota , and a a holds w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) , ι \iota and no mark in M M . These persist: ι \iota is never deleted (clause 1); a mark in M M is added at a role only where ι \iota is forbidden (clause 2 of its guardianship), so an agent holding ι \iota never gains one; and w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) is deleted at a a only when g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) is deleted at p p (clause 4). By clause 5, a transition adding w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) at an agent adds v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) there, and one deleting v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) there deletes w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) or finds it absent, so an agent holding w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) holds v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) ; and a transition adding v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) at an agent finds ι \iota there and no mark in M M , which persist as above. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 对运行进行归纳。 初始状态为空。 一个迁移由某个模式在绑定处确定的事务所引发，且仅通过该模式在该处添加和删除的原子来改变状态。 第 3 条保证 m m 原子与 g g 原子的计数在每个角色处都相等，并且由第 1 条，由于模式在单一角色处添加或删除它们，该相等性在每个智能体处也成立。 若某迁移在 p p 处添加 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a)，则由第 3 条它在 p p 处添加 m m，由第 2 条它在 p p 处添加 ι \iota，且由第 4 条其模式在某个要求 ι \iota 并禁止 M M 中所有标记的角色处含有 a a，并在 a a 处添加 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p)：因此迁移之后 p p 持有 ι \iota，而 a a 持有 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p)、ι \iota 以及 M M 中没有任何标记。 这些状态持续保持：ι \iota 从不被删除（第 1 条）；M M 中的标记仅在禁止 ι \iota 的角色处被添加（其监护权的第 2 条），因此持有 ι \iota 的智能体永远不会获得这样的标记；并且 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) 仅在 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) 在 p p 处被删除时才在 a a 处被删除（第 4 条）。 由第 5 条，在某个智能体处添加 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 的迁移会在该处添加 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x)，而删除该处 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) 的迁移会删除 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 或发现其不存在，因此持有 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 的智能体持有 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x)；并且在某个智能体处添加 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) 的迁移会发现该处存在 ι \iota 且 M M 中没有标记，而如上所述这些状态会持续保持。∎

sents.zh: 若某迁移在 p p 处添加 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a)，则由第 3 条它在 p p 处添加 m m，由第 2 条它在 p p 处添加 ι \iota，且由第 4 条其模式在某个要求 ι \iota 并禁止 M M 中所有标记的角色处含有 a a，并在 a a 处添加 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p)：因此迁移之后 p p 持有 ι \iota，而 a a 持有 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p)、ι \iota 以及 M M 中没有任何标记。

sents.en: These persist: ι \iota is never deleted (clause 1); a mark in M M is added at a role only where ι \iota is forbidden (clause 2 of its guardianship), so an agent holding ι \iota never gains one; and w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) is deleted at a a only when g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) is deleted at p p (clause 4).
sents.zh: 这些状态持续保持：ι \iota 从不被删除（第 1 条）；M M 中的标记仅在禁止 ι \iota 的角色处被添加（其监护权的第 2 条），因此持有 ι \iota 的智能体永远不会获得这样的标记；并且 w ⁡ ( p ) w(p) 仅在 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) 在 p p 处被删除时才在 a a 处被删除（第 4 条）。

sents.en: By clause 5, a transition adding w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) at an agent adds v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) there, and one deleting v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) there deletes w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) or finds it absent, so an agent holding w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) holds v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) ; and a transition adding v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) at an agent finds ι \iota there and no mark in M M , which persist as above. ∎
sents.zh: 由第 5 条，在某个智能体处添加 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 的迁移会在该处添加 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x)，而删除该处 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) 的迁移会删除 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 或发现其不存在，因此持有 w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) 的智能体持有 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x)；并且在某个智能体处添加 v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) 的迁移会发现该处存在 ι \iota 且 M M 中没有标记，而如上所述这些状态会持续保持。∎

paragraphs.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M . A mark ℓ ∉ M \ell\notin M is a leaving mark of C C if:
paragraphs.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都拥有一个监护关系。 一个标记 ℓ ∉ M \ell\notin M 是 C C 的离开标记，如果：

sents.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M .
sents.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都拥有一个监护关系。

sents.en: A mark ℓ ∉ M \ell\notin M is a leaving mark of C C if:
sents.zh: 一个标记 ℓ ∉ M \ell\notin M 是 C C 的离开标记，如果：

paragraphs.en: every guarding role of every schema of C C forbids ℓ \ell , and no schema of C C deletes ℓ \ell ;
paragraphs.zh: C 的每个模式（schema）的每个守护角色（guarding role）都禁止 ℓ \ell，且 C 的任何模式都不删除 ℓ \ell；

paragraphs.en: a schema that adds ℓ \ell at a role requires a mark in M M there;
paragraphs.zh: 一种在某个角色上添加 ℓ \ell 的模式需要在 M M 中有相应的标记；

paragraphs.en: a schema that adds, at a role, an atom g ⁡ ( σ ) g(\sigma) of the guardianship of a mark in M M forbids ℓ \ell at σ \sigma .
paragraphs.zh: 一种模式，它在某个角色处添加一个原子 g ⁡ ( σ ) g(\sigma)，表示 M M 中标记的监护权在 σ \sigma 处禁止 ℓ \ell。

paragraphs.en: Retirement under GnW: 5 is written with a leaving mark: the act by which the creator retires a ward adds it at the ward; here it is 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑑 \mathit{retired} , added by Retire.
paragraphs.zh: GnW 下的退役：5 带有离开标记书写：创建者退役某个被监护人（ward）的行为会在该被监护人处添加它；这里是 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑑 \mathit{retired}，由 Retire 添加。

paragraphs.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M and ℓ \ell be a leaving mark of C C . In every configuration of a run of the protocol realising C C , an agent holding ℓ \ell has left; and if an agent holds g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) for the guardianship ( m , ι , g , w , v ) (m,\iota,g,w,v) of a mark in M M , then a a does not hold ℓ \ell .
paragraphs.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都有一个监护，并且 ℓ \ell 是 C C 的一个离开标记。 在实现 C C 的协议的运行中的每个配置里，持有 ℓ \ell 的智能体已经离开；并且如果某个智能体持有 M M 中某个标记的监护 ( m , ι , g , w , v ) (m,\iota,g,w,v) 的 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a)，那么智能体 a a 不持有 ℓ \ell。

sents.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M and ℓ \ell be a leaving mark of C C .
sents.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都有一个监护，并且 ℓ \ell 是 C C 的一个离开标记。

sents.en: In every configuration of a run of the protocol realising C C , an agent holding ℓ \ell has left; and if an agent holds g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) for the guardianship ( m , ι , g , w , v ) (m,\iota,g,w,v) of a mark in M M , then a a does not hold ℓ \ell .
sents.zh: 在实现 C C 的协议的运行中的每个配置里，持有 ℓ \ell 的智能体已经离开；并且如果某个智能体持有 M M 中某个标记的监护 ( m , ι , g , w , v ) (m,\iota,g,w,v) 的 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a)，那么智能体 a a 不持有 ℓ \ell。

paragraphs.en: No schema deletes ℓ \ell (clause 1), so an agent holding ℓ \ell holds it in every later configuration. A transaction ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) with that agent in Q ′ Q^{\prime} sends them a guarding role, which forbids ℓ \ell (clause 1), so no such transaction is machine-enabled in a later configuration, and the agent has left. When an atom g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) is added at an agent, a a does not hold ℓ \ell (clause 3), and the act adds none at a a , whose role forbids every mark in M M (Definition C.10 , clause 4; clause 2); and while an agent holds g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) , a a holds no mark in M M (Lemma C.11 ), so no transition adds ℓ \ell at a a (clause 2). ∎
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何模式删除 ℓ \ell（第 1 条），因此持有 ℓ \ell 的智能体在之后的每个配置中都持有它。 一个带有该智能体在 Q ′ Q^{\prime} 中的事务 ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) 向其发送一个守护角色，该角色禁止 ℓ \ell（第 1 条），因此在之后的配置中没有任何这样的事务是机器使能的，且该智能体已经离开。 当在某个智能体处添加原子 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) 时，a a 不持有 ℓ \ell（第 3 条），并且该动作不会在 a a 处添加任何标记，因为 a a 的角色禁止 M M 中的每个标记（定义 C.10 第 4 条；第 2 条）；而且当某个智能体持有 g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) 时，a a 不持有 M M 中的任何标记（引理 C.11），因此没有任何迁移会在 a a 处添加 ℓ \ell（第 2 条）。∎

sents.en: No schema deletes ℓ \ell (clause 1), so an agent holding ℓ \ell holds it in every later configuration.
sents.zh: 没有任何模式删除 ℓ \ell（第 1 条），因此持有 ℓ \ell 的智能体在之后的每个配置中都持有它。

sents.en: A transaction ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) with that agent in Q ′ Q^{\prime} sends them a guarding role, which forbids ℓ \ell (clause 1), so no such transaction is machine-enabled in a later configuration, and the agent has left.

paragraphs.en: An introductory act τ \tau of C C that adds one atom at each role, of a predicate e e of arity one, is unobstructed but for M M if at each role π i \pi_{i} of τ \tau :
paragraphs.zh: 一个在 C C 中引入行为的开场动作 τ \tau，在每一个角色处各添加一个一元谓词 e e 的一个原子，若对于 τ \tau 的每个角色 π i \pi_{i} 满足：则称该动作除 M M 之外是无阻碍的：

paragraphs.en: every atom τ \tau requires at π i \pi_{i} , other than an atom of a reflexive predicate naming π i \pi_{i} , is, up to renaming the role, the one atom added by some schema of C C of arity one that is guarded in its role, requires nothing and forbids nothing but that atom and the leaving marks of C C ;
paragraphs.zh: 每个原子 τ \tau 在 π i \pi_{i} 处的要求是：除了命名 π i \pi_{i} 的自反谓词的原子之外，该原子在角色重命名意义上等同于某个 C C 中受其角色守卫的一元模式所添加的那个原子，该模式除了那个原子和 C C 的离开标记外既无要求也无禁止；

paragraphs.en: every atom τ \tau forbids at π i \pi_{i} is a mark in M M or a leaving mark of C C .
paragraphs.zh: 每个在 π i \pi_{i} 处被 τ \tau 禁用的原子，都是 M M 中的一个标记，或是 C C 的一个离开标记。

paragraphs.en: The act neither requires nor forbids an atom of e e , so two agents may take it whether or not each holds e e of the other, and a local state, a multiset, counts the copies; an agent may hold e e of an agent they never dealt with, as GKK: 3 introduces one agent to another. Acquaint, which forbids 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 \mathit{agent} at each role and adds 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} of the other there, is unobstructed but for { 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 } \{\mathit{agent}\} : it requires 𝑖𝑑𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑡𝑦 \mathit{identity} , which Establish adds (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 该行为既不要求也不禁止一个原子的 e e，因此无论两个智能体是否各自持有对方的 e e，它们都可以执行该行为；局部状态是一个多重集，会统计副本数量；智能体可以持有从未打过交道的智能体的 e e，例如 GKK: 3 将一个智能体介绍给另一个智能体。 Acquaint 在每个角色处禁止 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 \mathit{agent} 并在其中添加对另一方的 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows}，除 { 𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 } \{\mathit{agent}\} 外不受阻碍：它要求 𝑖𝑑𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑡𝑦 \mathit{identity}，而 Establish 会添加该要求（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M and τ \tau be an introductory act of C C unobstructed but for M M , adding atoms of e e . A schema χ \chi of C C is a relay act with related roles ρ 1 ≠ ρ 2 \rho_{1}\neq\rho_{2} , roles of it guarded in χ \chi at each of which χ \chi adds an atom of e e naming the other, if:
paragraphs.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都有一个守护，且 τ \tau 是 C C 的一个引入行为，除 M M 外不受阻碍，并添加 e e 的原子。 C C 的模式 χ \chi 是一个带相关角色 ρ 1 ≠ ρ 2 \rho_{1}\neq\rho_{2} 的中继行为，其角色在 χ \chi 中被守护，且 χ \chi 在每个角色处添加一个命名另一角色的 e e 的原子，若：

sents.en: Let C C have a guardianship for every mark in M M and τ \tau be an introductory act of C C unobstructed but for M M , adding atoms of e e .
sents.zh: 设 C C 对 M M 中的每个标记都有一个守护，且 τ \tau 是 C C 的一个引入行为，除 M M 外不受阻碍，并添加 e e 的原子。

sents.en: A schema χ \chi of C C is a relay act with related roles ρ 1 ≠ ρ 2 \rho_{1}\neq\rho_{2} , roles of it guarded in χ \chi at each of which χ \chi adds an atom of e e naming the other, if:
sents.zh: C C 的模式 χ \chi 是一个带相关角色 ρ 1 ≠ ρ 2 \rho_{1}\neq\rho_{2} 的中继行为，其角色在 χ \chi 中被守护，且 χ \chi 在每个角色处添加一个命名另一角色的 e e 的原子，若：

paragraphs.en: each related role ρ \rho is a ward role of some m ∈ M m\in M , requiring m m , with exactly one other role σ \sigma of χ \chi , its guardian role , requiring v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) , the v v of the guardianship of m m , a guardian of the ward (GnW: 3 and GnW: 4 ), or a free role , forbidding every mark in M M ; every role of χ \chi is a related role or a guardian role; and χ \chi adds and deletes at a guardian role no atom naming another guardian role;
paragraphs.zh: 每个相关角色 ρ \rho 是某个 m ∈ M m\in M 的受监护角色（ward role），要求 m m 与 χ \chi 中恰好一个其他角色 σ \sigma （其监护角色，guardian role）要求 v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) ，即 m m 的监护关系的 v v ，作为受监护人的监护人（GnW: 3 与 GnW: 4 ），或者是一个自由角色（free role），禁止 M M 中的每个标记（mark）；χ \chi 的每个角色是相关角色或监护角色；并且 χ \chi 在监护角色处不添加也不删除命名另一个监护角色的任何原子；

paragraphs.en: every atom χ \chi requires at a role is an atom of a reflexive predicate naming the role; or, up to renaming the role, the one atom of a schema of arity one as in clause 1 of Definition C.14 ; or, at a ward role, its m m or g ⁡ ( σ ) g(\sigma) ; or, at a ward role of m m , an atom of a predicate h h whose arguments are distinct speech-act variables of χ \chi occurring in no other atom χ \chi requires but its record below, where every schema of C C that adds m m at a role ρ \rho adds there an atom of h h whose arguments are speech-act variables or signed terms, and adds its record , an atom of a predicate h ′ h^{\prime} whose arguments are ρ \rho and the arguments of that h h -atom, at the role at which it adds w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho) ; every other schema of C C that adds v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) at a role requires a record h ′ ​ ( ρ , … ) h^{\prime}(\rho,\ldots) at a role at which it requires w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho) , and adds that record where it adds v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) ; and no schema of C C deletes an atom of h h or of h ′ h^{\prime} ; or, at the guardian role σ \sigma of a ward role ρ \rho , the atom v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) or w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho) of that guardianship, or the record, the atom of h ′ h^{\prime} whose arguments are ρ \rho and the arguments of the h h -atom ρ \rho requires; or, at a guardian role or a free role, e ⁡ ( κ ) e(\kappa) for another guardian role or free role κ \kappa , with e e reflexive where both are guardian roles; or, where χ \chi has two ward roles, at the guardian role of one, e e of the other ward role (GnW: 4 );
paragraphs.zh: 每一个原子 χ \chi 在某一角色处要求的，是一个命名该角色的自反谓词的原子；或者，在对角色重命名后，如定义 C.14 第 1 条中那样一元模式的唯一一个原子；或者，在被监护角色处，其 m m 或 g ⁡ ( σ ) g(\sigma)；或者，在具有 m m 的被监护角色处，一个谓词 h h 的原子，其参数是 χ \chi 中未出现在其他任何 χ \chi 所要求的原子中、仅出现在其下述记录中的互不相同的言语行为变量，其中 C C 中每一个在角色 ρ \rho 处添加 m m 的模式，都在该处添加一个 h h 的原子，其参数为言语行为变量或带符号项，并添加其记录，即一个谓词 h ′ h^{\prime} 的原子，其参数为 ρ \rho 和该 h h 原子的参数，位置在其添加 w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho) 的角色处；C C 中每一个在某一角色处添加 v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) 的其他模式，在其要求 w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho) 的角色处要求一条记录 h ′ ​ ( ρ , … ) h^{\prime}(\rho,\ldots)，并在其添加 v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) 的位置添加该记录；并且 C C 中没有模式删除 h h 或 h ′ h^{\prime} 的原子；或者，在被监护角色 ρ \rho 的监护角色 σ \sigma 处，该监护关系的原子 v ⁡ ( ρ ) v(\rho) 或 w ⁡ ( ρ ) w(\rho)，或该记录，即一个 h ′ h^{\prime} 的原子，其参数为 ρ \rho 和 ρ \rho 所要求的 h h 原子的参数；或者，在某监护角色或自由角色处，另一监护角色或自由角色 κ \kappa 的 e ⁡ ( κ ) e(\kappa)，当两者均为监护角色时 e e 是自反的；或者，当 χ \chi 具有两个被监护角色时，在其中之一的监护角色处，另一被监护角色的 e e（GnW: 4）；

paragraphs.en: every atom χ \chi forbids at a role is a mark in M M or a leaving mark of C C .
paragraphs.zh: 每一个在角色处禁止的原子 χ \chi 都是 M M 中的一个标记，或 C C 的一个离开标记。

paragraphs.en: A relay act is an act by which a ward and another agent come to know each other, with the guardian of each ward among them. Agent acquaint is a relay act with a ward role, the AI agent, a free role, the person, and a guardian of the AI agent as the guardian role, requiring at the AI agent the attestation its principal gave it on entering, an atom of h h in clause 2, and at the guardian its record, from which the guardian’s machine fills the request; Agents acquaint is one with two ward roles and their two guardian roles, the guardian of the one requiring 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} of the other AI agent. In the child-safe social network a child and an adult come to know each other by a relay act with the child’s parent as the guardian role, requiring of the parent 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} of the adult, and two children by one with two ward roles and their two parents, requiring of each parent 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} of the other, which binds both parents to one person where the two children share one, 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} being reflexive ( Shapiro, 2026a ) . Befriending, which requires 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} of the other at each role, is not a relay act in either contract.
paragraphs.zh: 转介行为是被监护人（ward）与另一个智能体（agent）相互结识的行为，双方监护人也在其中。 智能体结识（agent acquaint）是一种转介行为，具有一个被监护人角色（AI 智能体）、一个自由角色（人）以及作为监护人角色的 AI 智能体的监护人，要求 AI 智能体提供其委托人在进入时给予的证明（第 2 条中的原子 h h），并要求监护人提供其记录，监护人机器据此填写请求；智能体相互结识（agents acquaint）则是一种具有两个被监护人角色及其两个监护人角色的转介行为，其中一方的监护人要求对另一方 AI 智能体的 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows}。 在儿童安全的社交网络中，儿童与成人通过一种以儿童家长为监护人角色的转介行为相互结识，该行为要求家长对成人具有 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows}；两个儿童则通过一种具有两个被监护人角色及其双方家长的转介行为相互结识，该行为要求每位家长对对方具有 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows}，当两个儿童共享同一位家长时，这便将两位家长绑定到同一个人身上，𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows} 是自反的（Shapiro, 2026a）。 好友缔结（befriending）要求在每个角色上对对方具有 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤𝑠 \mathit{knows}，它在这两个契约中都不是转介行为。

paragraphs.en: C C has an introduction with wards if it has a nonempty set M M of marks, a guardianship for each mark in M M , an introductory act unobstructed but for M M , and, for every m , m ′ ∈ M m,m^{\prime}\in M , a relay act with a ward role of m m and a free role and a relay act with a ward role of m m and a ward role of m ′ m^{\prime} .
paragraphs.zh: 如果 C C 拥有一个非空的标记集合 M M、对 M M 中每个标记的监护关系、一个除 M M 外无阻碍的引入动作，并且对于每个 m , m ′ ∈ M m,m^{\prime}\in M，拥有一个带 m m 的被监护角色和一个自由角色的中继动作，以及一个带 m m 的被监护角色和 m ′ m^{\prime} 的被监护角色的中继动作，那么 C C 具有带标记的引入。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the rest of this appendix C C is a contract with an introduction with wards, traceable provenance and volition, R C R_{C} its realisation and ℱ \mathcal{F} the protocol realising it.
paragraphs.zh: 在本附录的其余部分中，C C 是一份具有前言、可追溯来源与意志（volition）的合约，R C R_{C} 是其实现，而 ℱ \mathcal{F} 是实现该合约的协议。

paragraphs.en: A set R R of volition-guarded transactions is open among the agents that have not left if for any two agents p ≠ q p\neq q in any Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , every finite safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) with no interaction between p p and q q , in whose last configuration neither p p nor q q has left, has a finite safe extension, by volition changes and transitions that are not interactions between p p and q q , at whose end some transaction of R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) whose induced transitions are interactions between p p and q q is machine-enabled.
paragraphs.zh: 一个意志保护的交易集合 R R，若满足以下条件，则称其在尚未离开的智能体之间是开放的：对于任意 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi 中的任意两个智能体 p ≠ q p\neq q，ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的每一条在最后配置中 p p 和 q q 均未离开、且 p p 与 q q 之间无交互的有限安全运行，都存在一个由意志变化以及非 p p 与 q q 之间交互的转移构成的有限安全扩展，在该扩展结束时，R ⁡ ( Q ) R(Q) 中某个其诱导转移为 p p 与 q q 之间交互的交易是机器可启用的。

paragraphs.en: An open set is open among the agents that have not left.
paragraphs.zh: 在尚未离开的智能体中，一个开集是开的。

paragraphs.en: R C R_{C} is open among the agents that have not left, and open if C C has no leaving mark.
paragraphs.zh: R C R_{C} 在尚未离开的智能体中是开放的，且当 C C 没有离开标记时是开放的。

paragraphs.en: Let p ≠ q p\neq q in Q Q , let r r be a finite safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) with no interaction between p p and q q , and let c c be its last configuration, at which, if C C has a leaving mark, neither p p nor q q has left; by Lemma C.13 , neither holds a leaving mark at c c . Call x ∈ Q x\in Q a ward at c c if its state holds a mark in M M , which by Lemma C.11 is one mark m m and comes with g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) for some a a , its creator, whom we take as its guardian , who holds w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) , v ⁡ ( x ) v(x) and ι \iota and no mark; otherwise x x is free . Two facts. First, the transition that added g ⁡ ( a ) g(a) at a ward x x was determined by a schema with a a in a role at which it added w ⁡ ( x ) w(x) (Definition C.10 , clause 4), so it changed both states (Lemma C.8 (1)), left x x recording a a , and was an interaction between x x and a a ; so the guardian of p p , if p p is a ward, is not q q , and that of q q is not p p . Second, for free x ≠ y x\neq y in Q Q holding no leaving mark, the introductory act τ \tau at the introduction of x x and y y can be made machine-enabled by unary transitions at x x and at y y : an atom τ \tau requires that is absent is the one atom of a schema of arity one requiring nothing and forbidding nothing but that atom and the leaving marks, which is machine-enabled, and adding it adds nothing τ \tau forbids, as a schema of arity one requiring nothing adds no mark in M M , such a mark being added only together with a g g -atom naming another role (Definition C.10 , clauses 3 and 4), and no leaving mark, which is added only where a mark in M M is required (Definition C.12 , clause 2); and what τ \tau forbids is a mark in M M , absent at the free x x and y y , or a leaving mark, absent at x x and y y . Taking τ \tau there, after volition changes of x x and y y , leaves x x holding e ⁡ ( y ) e(y) and y y holding e ⁡ ( x ) e(x) , and is an interaction between x x and y y and no others.
paragraphs.zh: 设 p≠q 属于 Q，设 r 为 ℱ(Q) 的一个有限安全运行，其中 p 与 q 之间没有交互，并设 c 为其最后一个配置；在该配置处，若 C 带有离场标记，则 p 和 q 均未离场；由引理 C.13，二者在 c 处都不持有离场标记。 称 x∈Q 在 c 处为一个受监护者，若其状态持有 M 中的某个标记，由引理 C.11 该标记是单个标记 m，并伴随某个 a 的 g(a)，a 是其创建者，我们将其取为受监护者的监护人，该监护人持有 w(x)、v(x) 与 ι 且不持有任何标记；否则称 x 为自由者。有两个事实。 第一，在受监护者 x 处添加 g(a) 的那个转移由一个模式确定，其中 a 处于某个角色，且该转移添加了 w(x)（定义 C.10 第 4 条），因此它改变了两个状态（引理 C.8（1）），使 x 记录下 a，并且是 x 与 a 之间的一个交互；故若 p 是受监护者，则 p 的监护人不是 q，而 q 的监护人也不是 p。 第二，对于 Q 中持有离场标记的自由者 x≠y，x 与 y 被引入时的引入动作 τ 可以通过在 x 处和在 y 处的一元转移使之成为机器可启用的：τ 所要求缺失的那个原子是一个一元模式的唯一原子，该模式不要求任何东西且除该原子和离场标记外不禁止任何东西，它是机器可启用的，且添加它不会添加 τ 所禁止的任何东西，因为一元的不要求任何东西的模式不会添加 M 中的任何标记，这种标记只会与命名另一角色的 g-原子一起被添加（定义 C.10 第 3 条和第 4 条），也不会添加离场标记，离场标记只在要求 M 中标记的地方才被添加（定义 C.12 第 2 条）；而 τ 所禁止的是 M 中的某个标记——在自由的 x 和 y 处缺失——或某个离场标记——在 x 和 y 处缺失。 在 x 和 y 的意愿变化之后取那里的 τ，会留下持有 e(y) 的 x 和持有 e(x) 的 y，并且是 x 与 y 之间且仅介于二者之间的一个交互。

paragraphs.en: If p p and q q are free, the second fact at x := p x:=p and y := q y:=q gives an extension by unary transitions after which τ \tau at their introduction is machine-enabled, and every transaction it determines is a mutual recording of p p and q q , so its transitions are interactions between p p and q q by Lemma C.8 (2).
paragraphs.zh: 如果 p p 和 q q 是自由的，则在 x := p x:=p 和 y := q y:=q 处应用第二个事实，经过若干一元转移的扩展后，τ \tau 在其引入处是机器可启用的，并且它确定的每个事务都是 p p 和 q q 的相互记录，因此根据引理 C.8 (2)，其转移是 p p 和 q q 之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: Otherwise let χ \chi be the relay act for the statuses of p p and q q , bound with its ward roles to those of p p and q q that are wards, its free role to the free one, and the guardian role of each ward role to that ward’s guardian, and the speech-act variables of each atom of a predicate h h that χ \chi requires at a ward role, as clause 2 of Definition C.15 admits, to the arguments of an atom of h h held by the ward bound there, which holds one: the transition that added its mark added one, and no transition deletes one; every transition that added v v of the ward at an agent added its record there, with the arguments of the ward’s h h -atom, and no transition deletes one, so the guardian holds it under the binding. The related roles are bound to distinct agents, and two guardian roles are bound to one person only where p p and q q share a guardian, which GnW: 4 admits, Alice and Bob possibly one person, and Definition C.2 permits as the guardian roles add and delete nothing naming each other. Extend r r as follows, by transitions none of which is an interaction between p p and q q : for every atom χ \chi requires at a role that is the one atom of a schema of arity one and is absent at the agent bound there, the unary transition adding it, machine-enabled as above; and for every e ⁡ ( κ ) e(\kappa) required at a guardian role or free role bound to x x , with κ \kappa bound to y ≠ x y\neq x , where x x does not hold e ⁡ ( y ) e(y) , the unary transitions and the transaction of τ \tau at the introduction of x x and y y by the second fact, x x and y y being free by Lemma C.11 , holding no leaving mark, as p p and q q hold none and a guardian holds none by Lemma C.13 , and { x , y } ≠ { p , q } \{x,y\}\neq\{p,q\} , since a guardian is bound only where its ward is one of p p and q q , and is not the other by the first fact; and, where χ \chi has two ward roles, for e ⁡ ( κ ) e(\kappa) required at the guardian role bound to x x , with κ \kappa the other ward role, bound to the ward y y , whose guardian is b b , where x x does not hold e ⁡ ( y ) e(y) : first e ⁡ ( b ) e(b) at x x , as above, and then the relay act with ward role y y , free role x x and guardian role b b , made machine-enabled as in this paragraph, its e e -atoms being between free agents, which leaves x x holding e ⁡ ( y ) e(y) and is no interaction between p p and q q , x x being neither.

paragraphs.en: The protocol over a contained set of volition-guarded transactions that is closed and open among the agents that have not left is volitionally grassroots.
paragraphs.zh: 在一组由意志守护的、对尚未离开的智能体保持封闭与开放的交易之上运行的协议是意志上自下而上的。

paragraphs.en: Let R R be such a set and ℱ \mathcal{F} the protocol over it. By Lemma C.8 (7) ℱ \mathcal{F} is oblivious, and the first interaction of two disjoint sets of agents in a safe run is induced by a transaction guarded by a member of each. Let Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi , let P , P ′ ⊆ Q P,P^{\prime}\subseteq Q be disjoint and nonempty, and let r ^ \hat{r} be a prefix of a correct run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) containing no interaction between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} , in whose last configuration p ∈ P p\in P and q ∈ P ′ q\in P^{\prime} have not left. By Definition C.17 some finite safe extension of r ^ \hat{r} , by volition changes and transitions that are not interactions between p p and q q , ends where some ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R ⁡ ( Q ) (t,Q^{\prime})\in R(Q) whose induced transitions are interactions between p p and q q is machine-enabled. If a transition of the extension is an interaction between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} , the extension contains one. Otherwise extend it by a volition change of each agent of Q ′ Q^{\prime} , where needed, so that [ t ] [t] lies in the volitional state of each, and by the volitional machine transaction that ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) then induces, an interaction between p p and q q and hence between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} . Either way the result is a finite safe run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) having r ^ \hat{r} as a prefix and containing an interaction between P P and P ′ P^{\prime} , and by Lemma Extension of ( Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026 ) it is a prefix of a correct run of ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) . So ℱ \mathcal{F} is interactive among the agents that have not left, and volitionally grassroots. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 设 R R 为这样一个集合，ℱ \mathcal{F} 为其上的协议。 由引理 C.8 (7)，ℱ \mathcal{F} 是无感知的（oblivious），且在安全运行中两个不相交智能体集合的首次交互由由各自成员守卫的事务所引发。 设 Q ⊂ Π Q\subset\Pi ，设 P , P ′ ⊆ Q P,P^{\prime}\subseteq Q 不相交且非空，并设 r ^ \hat{r} 为 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的一个正确运行的前缀，其中不含 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间的交互，且在其最后格局中 p ∈ P p\in P 与 q ∈ P ′ q\in P^{\prime} 尚未离开。 由定义 C.17，r ^ \hat{r} 的某个有限安全扩展，通过意愿变化以及非 p p 与 q q 之间交互的转移，终止于某个 ( t , Q ′ ) ∈ R ⁡ ( Q ) (t,Q^{\prime})\in R(Q) 机器使能的状态，其中该二元组所引发的转移是 p p 与 q q 之间的交互。 如果该扩展中的某个转移是 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间的交互，则该扩展已包含一个这样的交互。 否则，在需要时通过 Q ′ Q^{\prime} 中每个智能体的意愿变化对其加以扩展，使得 [ t ] [t] 位于每个智能体的意愿状态中，再通过 ( t , Q ′ ) (t,Q^{\prime}) 由此引发的意愿机器事务，得到 p p 与 q q 之间、从而也是 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间的交互。 无论如何，结果都是 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的一个有限安全运行，它以 r ^ \hat{r} 为前缀并含有 P P 与 P ′ P^{\prime} 之间的交互，且由（Lewis-Pye and Shapiro, 2026）的引理 Extension，它是 ℱ ⁡ ( Q ) \mathcal{F}(Q) 的一个正确运行的前缀。 因此 ℱ \mathcal{F} 在尚未离开的智能体之间是交互式的，且在意愿上是草根式的。∎

paragraphs.en: The protocol realising a contract with an introduction with wards, traceable provenance and volition is volitionally grassroots.
paragraphs.zh: 实现带有监护人引入、可追溯来源与意志的合约的协议，是具有意志的草根式协议。

paragraphs.en: By Proposition C.18 R C R_{C} is open among the agents that have not left. The proof of closure (Lemma C.8 (5)) uses traceable provenance and volition and nothing of the introductory act, so R C R_{C} is closed, and by Lemma C.8 (3), whose proof uses traceable provenance only, it is contained; both hold with reflexive predicates by Lemma C.9 .
